reviews.text: Beautiful beach filled with locals and tourists.  Wonderful white sand, lots of surfers.  Also lots to do around the area.  Different places for food, drinks and shopping. A fun place to go for the day.

reviews.title: Nice to see it again after many years
reviews.text: Fifty years ago as a young fellow I spent a fair bit of time here so it was great to visit again,This time though we just came on the hop on hop off bus with friends from Canada.It was a lovely sunny day with a slight breeze, perfect weather to show off one of Australia’s iconic beaches to overseas visitors.For a Tuesday there were quite a few people about and as usual there were plenty of surfers out there doing there stuff..The beach and water still looked inviting, still a nice place to enjoy, where have all the years gone.

reviews.title: Nice
reviews.text: Bondi is the beach with the reputation. It's really nice, clean and protected by life guards. Popular with the surfing set but there it's not a great deal going on. That's not to say that there is anything wrong with Bondi, but if you want a bigger beach with a bit of life going on around it Manly is the place to be.

reviews.title: Beautiful View for 5 Minutes
reviews.text: If you’re a surfer, I’m assume you will rate this 5+ stars. If you’re a tourist in October, it’s a beautiful walk that you can enjoy for a bit if you don’t mind the very strong wind (bring a sweater/jacket with a hood) and the time/effort it takes to come from the more central parts of Sydney. The shops along the beach front rip you off, even saying that a small bottle of water costs $2 then take $3.5 when you pay. The view is definitely worth it for a few minutes it but keep your expectations low for this famous beach and you’ll enjoy it.

reviews.title: Just as I would have Expected.
reviews.text: Had a day in Sydney and wanted to take in Bondi Beach.It was all that I expected except the day we went it was very windy.Great beach with lovely lawn areas.Plenty of eating houses and shops on one side of the road.Took the 333 bus from the city which took us all the way Always wanted to visit and put on my bucket list and now done.Well worth the visit.

reviews.title: Sun and surf
reviews.text: Best beach in Sydney :PFinding parking can be a bit tricky during peak season but it is worth it. Clean and pretty beach

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: My husband and I travel frequently and Austrailia was NOT on my bucket list. It is NOW! Bondi Beach was so beautiful, the water is the prettiest blue/green, the scenery around it was amazing, I couldn't get enough. The city itself is not as clean as Manly Beach, but the ocean is just breathtaking.

reviews.title: Nice views,
reviews.text: The beach is very nice & clean ..Has long trail for walking around the Beach with gorgeous views,  clean bathrooms, restaurants and life guards

reviews.title: Its free and as Sydney as you get.
reviews.text: Great stop for a beach day out, watching the people trot by or exercise with the best of them.  Bondi has always had a free and easy life style approach and nothing much has changed throughout the ages.  Great Cafe, Restaurants and Pubs along the front with some of the best cake shops I have ever tried.

reviews.title: Cold but pretty
reviews.text: We went yesterday and it was really windy and cold, but some were still simming and even surfing! Nice sand beach

reviews.title: Best beach in the world
reviews.text: Ok I know I am bias but dont you think so too? I just love Bondi Beach been coming here since I was a very small child and it never disappoints

reviews.title: Holidays
reviews.text: Not as impressive as we thought, worth going though. Lots of cafes, shops and bars.Easy to get too as local buses very regular and not expensive.

reviews.title: Lovely way to spend an evening ,eyeing the sunset
reviews.text: A short journey from Circular quay, its a lovely way to spend the evening and enjoy the sunset. Vast expanse of clean sand and clean water with chilly wind blowing across. Not crowded, with cafes nearby. The wall art along the beach is worth the visit , just walk along and enjoy the beauty of the painted walls; the messages  conveyed ,or merely the beauty of the scene.

reviews.title: Really nothing special
reviews.text: After visiting Camps  Bay in Cape Town I keep thinking that not much happens on Bondi BeachRelatively dirty, kids, dogs, food, drinks on a small beach

reviews.title: Busy popular beach
reviews.text: It was crazy busy.. and it's not even summer. Soft white sand with shops and eateries surrounding the beach. Train from CBD was busy and trying to catch 333 bus was worse. Buses got filled up in no time, so queued built up very quickly.

reviews.title: Picture perfect beach. Not.
reviews.text: Terrible parking situation, beach is always packed, too many backpackers and tourists, way overrated.

reviews.title: Quick stop at bondi!
reviews.text: Had a trip down to Bondi one morning. Lovely beach, lots of people around. Highly recommend the walk from Bondi-Coogee! Best coastal walk I’ve done. Takes around 2 hours at a good pace.

reviews.title: A beauty!
reviews.text: Coming from a country without beautiful beaches , i really enjoyed the stroll down bondi beach, peaceful n calm ( mayb bcause it wasnt d peak period..). The best part is that me n wife had a chance to see a whale flippin in a distance.. it was just.. wow! Theres also a fitness corner to mingle, n lots of pictures to take along the way..

reviews.title: To See and Be Seen
reviews.text: Talk about fine granulated sand, talk about a beautiful ocean with strong surf, talk about surfers, the wind and the sun. Talk about a famous beach and when you talk about Sydney, one place definitely comes to mind: Bondi beach. And from it, everyone will think of all the adjectives that could properly define the place. From people who have the chance to go Down Under, it is not only a must place to see but in a proper perspective, it is a must place to be seen. Not much can be said about Bondi Beach that haven’t been written yet. It is so famous that even sharks, if allowed, would like to frequent the waters of Bondi.

reviews.title: Bondi Beach
reviews.text: Exactly how it is seen on ‘Bondi beach rescue’ show.Great opportunity to see popular lifeguards off show. It was clean and has green park area to sit and small cafe on beachside.All kind of shops across the road.Paid parking expensive but very close to everything and still worth it.so close to get too, its a must see if visiting Sydney.

reviews.title: Too Crowed
reviews.text: Went to the beach to see what all the hoopla was about. Well I saw for myself. The beach was overly crowded for me. Trash cans were overflowing. The bar on the beach was packed. Life guards were doing an excellent job of pulling people out of the ocean. Groups of people taped off areas for their people so that area did not become public. Come early if you want to get a good parking spot.

reviews.title: Best place ever
reviews.text: We love going here to eat and to pass our time when we don't have anything to doPlace worth visiting for special events too

reviews.title: Famous beach of Australia
reviews.text: No visit to Sydney would be complete without a visit to the famous Bondi beach. Even though it  was cold and raining, it didnt deter our enthusiasm. Car drive was around 7-8 km from Sydney and was comfortable. Beach was empty because of the weather. However surfers were there surfing inspite the cold. The curved beach itself is beautiful and we walked quite a distance. Lining the beach are boutique shops, cafes and bars.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Beautiful coastline - easy walk along cliff tops from Tamarama Beach to Bondi. Stop into Icebergs for a drink and enjoy the view.

reviews.title: Better than I expected
reviews.text: I have to say that I thought this would be a commercial type beach and it was not !!!! Stunning beach great surf loads to do great restaurants. Awesome

What a beautiful beach. Golden sands and plenty of room. I’d imagine during the summer season you’d not get moved on the beach. Plenty of places to eat and buy supplies from one of the many businesses down the shop front.

reviews.title: Bondi beach brilliant
reviews.text: We visited bondi beach on a Sunday morning the beach is really clean water inviting spent all day there then we wanted something to eat at teatime we found ourselves in the bondi RSL  we where made to feel really welcome great.food and some really nice Austrailian ex service personnel  thankyou from a pomm ex forces

reviews.title: A must see when in Sydney
reviews.text: Beautiful beach/coast line, popular with surfers! Plenty of cafes along the front. Lots of sitting areas for picnics too. A really easy bus ride from Sydney. A worth while a trip.

reviews.title: Obligatory tourist stop
reviews.text: We came to Bondi specifically because of the show Bondi rescue. Littlest son is a massive fan. So took the 333 bus from Sydney central to Bondi, took about 40 min. There was a few souvenir shops and general clothing and food shops. Bondi beach itself was average. I’m from Perth and our beaches are a lot cleaner and bigger with clearer water so I wasn’t awed by the beach itself.Son was happy to take pics at the lifeguard tower but didn’t get the chance to meet any of the boys from the show. Oh well. I also stopped at the bondi beach gym for some photos on the fanous Bondi pole. That was really good.

reviews.title: The nicest thing in Sydney
reviews.text: Was blown away when i was hereExpected it to be just a beach but more than thatBondi Beach is extremely big with lots of pple, surfing, picnic, jogging, walking their dogs, etcProbably cuz from where im from, beaches are much less activeSpent quite a while there and took the walk to coogee (though i gave up less than halfway uz its too far)Love the view, also at the iceberg club, the swimming pool is fantastic with ocean wavesc itting against itThe walk to coogee, started past the iceberg club and with amazing view of the ocean, mountain walks along the coast with its up and down slopes. Can be tiring and the wind is strong hereThe place feels very chill, like a beach town but clean and nice waters and sandBeen to several beach towns like phuket or krabi in thailand, this place is much betterWent to a cafhe(the famous Trio) for a ch ilax coffee breakHighly recommend this place if you are in Sydney, this is the place that makes me like Sydney over Melbourne Too gorgeousOh and if you think my expectations might be too low, I went to Hyams Beach (the famous beach for its white sands), i prefer this much MUCH moreeeeHope my review is helpful for you, like if it doesl

reviews.title: Mr. Adrian Lee
reviews.text: Love the Mother Nature of this beach, the sensational movement of the waves makes soothing and a sense of serenity to your ears. It gives a sense of peace and tranquility both mind, body and soul. However, we were not able to take a proper picture near the beach as it was heavily down pour with stormy windy temperature. Hence, we are grateful and thankful for the opportunity to be here ☺️☺️

reviews.title: Very Beautiful
reviews.text: Mind-blowing experience, very beautiful beach, lots of options for food and sports. One should definitely go for surfing if visiting Bondi Beach

reviews.title: Nice Beach & Boardwalk
reviews.text: Stopped at Bondi Beach on a tour. Beautiful beach & water. Nice stroll along the beach boardwalk, a few stores & restaurants. If not doing beach or water activites, you won't need more than one hour to visit.

reviews.title: Kite festival
reviews.text: The day visited was the day of kite festival on September 8th. A lot of people and traffic jam. Hundreds of kite flying along the beach.It was fun to watch.  Bondi Beach is beautiful. Worth visit and spend half day here while you are in Sydney. Buss 333 from city center (across Sheraton Grande) takes you here without transferring. You need to buy Opal Card in advance to get this bus.

reviews.title: Do it! Dare the walk from Bondi Beach to Coogee Beach
reviews.text: If you enjoy ocean breeze, pounding waves and a hearty 2.5-3 h walk then you'll be in heaven.Great coves and beaches at every turn, lean surfers& beach bodies and amazing views.It is a bit strenuous, while always on a cement foot path you do end up "pounding the pavement ". But there's a beer once you enter Coogee! (Check out the Coogee pavilion!)

reviews.title: Great place to swim and relax
reviews.text: I love to go swimming in the ocean almost every morning in summer. Bondi Beach is an excellent place for that. It is quite safe, there are lifeguards. It was great to see them practicing. There is also a number of good eateries and gift and other shops.

reviews.title: Love it
reviews.text: Great beach surrounded in coffee shops and restaurants with some phenomenal street art! Must visit in Sydney!

reviews.title: Walk
reviews.text: Nice place to for beach walk and for a swim, during summer it so crowded,  views and the ambiance it's a good experience, beachin the city

reviews.title: Festival of the Winds - Bondi Beach
reviews.text: This fantastic festival is sadly only one Sunday a year at Australia’s iconic Bondi Beach Sydney. This year it was Sunday 8th September from 11am till 4pm . Amazing day with hundred of balloons circling and gliding in the near perfect conditions above the stunning surf and sand that is always beautiful Bondi. Kites are for sale and kit making classes are also offered on the day. A huge stay of food stalls with outstanding food of all varieties on offer . The event is free to attend and live music and entertainment is on all day. People are welcome to bring their own kites to fly however you can only fly kites on the grass area above the beach as the sand is for the professional displays only. Parking of course is always difficult and is metered in most areas but there are lots of buses available for transport from the city and various outer suburbs. Highly recommend this fabulous outdoor activity.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: What a beach, plenty to see and do, walk along the beach or just sit on the grass and have a picnic, there is tables there if you wish. Plenty of food outlets to choose from right across the road, there is also a Woolworths near by if you wish to purchase food there, and if you forget your sunscreen Chemist warehouse is just across the road. It’s a day for all ages, but you have to pay for parking, so I recommend public transport which takes you right to the beach, regardless what direction your coming from. Swim between the flags for your safety.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Visited Bondi in August. it was a beautiful and serene visit. the view was breathtaking and despite the cold weather. i am very happy to have visited. clear blue sea, beautiful beach and great atmosphere.

reviews.title: Wonderful day out
reviews.text: Staying in the CBD, we took a bus to Bondi as the trains were not working, but it was easy, an overcast day we had a lovely time walking around and had a beautiful breakfast at the Bondi Bathers overlooking the ocean.

reviews.title: Gorgeous
reviews.text: Beautiful, famous, touristy beach, very crowded with tanners/swimmers/surfers/strollers; a great place to start off a walk along the ocean with plenty of photo ops, people watching, volleyballers, incredible views, rock formations, different beaches/neighborhoods, an oceanside cemetery, etc. Sugarcane, in Coogee is a great restaurant for lunch.

reviews.title: Baecation
reviews.text: Had an amazing time at Bondi beach with my lover. Victor was quite friendly and ensured we enjoyed our stay

reviews.title: Long beach
reviews.text: Many people come here to surf, the view here is beautiful and can walk from bondi beach to bronte beach, and you can see the bondi icebergs pool on the way, it's nice.

reviews.title: Amazing Beach
reviews.text: An amazing place to have a swim or just relax and bake in the sun. There is also a trail that close by that you can follow if you are interested in going on a calming walk.

reviews.title: Great Beach and Place to Learn Surfing
reviews.text: While not as big as Manly, it has a casual feel with an amazing beach. It is a great place to surf because the waves have a nice break between the shallow and deeper water, and are very consistent with wind patterns. The water is also calm enough to swim in, which I personally enjoyed.There is also a Pavillion that you can store your stuff in if you want to take a sudden dip. There are also numerous shops, parks, and restaurants to explore. It has a San Fransico feel but more laid back.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: I was able to experience both sides of the Pacific Ocean within a span of 24 hours. The waves were beautiful. I was able to see the pool that gets its water from the ocean. I've wanted to see that for years. There were some restaurants and little shops close to the beach. The street art was beautiful as well.

reviews.title: The most famous beach of Sydney!
reviews.text: Bondi Beach is best known for its waves, which make it one of the top surfing destinations in the world. Bondi is also nice for strolling, sunbathing and swimming. Despite its popularity (and its plentiful souvenir shops and surf and fashion boutiques), Bondi maintains an alternative, edgy feel. Topless sunbathing is allowed here as well, though it's mostly limited to areas without children.Almost universally, it is said the 6-mile trek to Bondi is a must and that the beach is one of the most beautiful in the world (to claim a prime spot on the sand, it is suggested to arrive early). Many former visitors also recommend setting aside time for one of the region's coastal walks. Both the Bondi to Coogee walk and the Bondi to Bronte walk offer superb water views and relaxing spots for picnics.TRANSPORTS: the best way to get to Bondi Beach, is by train or bus. From Central Station, you can take a train bound for Bondi Junction and then catch the 333 bus to reach the beach. You can also pick up the 380 bus from Circular Quay. Limited parking is available, though driving here is not encouraged. A visit to Bondi is free, but expect to pay for area amenities like food and souvenirs. Public bathrooms and outdoor showers, which are located throughout the beachfront area, are also free to use.

reviews.title: Sun and Shopping
reviews.text: There was not much to do at Bondi Beach except sit on the beach or go through a few souvenir shops. If you are on the Sydney Big Red Bus tour, then take some time to stop here and see the beach. Otherwise, I don't think it's worth anyone's time to explicitly drive over to Bondi when there are many other more truly cultural things that can be explored in the city. The bus ride back from Bondi was actually more exciting then Bondi itself because it took you through up-scale neighborhoods where you could have a good sense of what living in Sydney is like for well-off citizens.

reviews.title: A nice-to-see
reviews.text: Our family took us here and we were told it was a pretty iconic tourist destination so we certainly were intrigued.  It is a lovely crescent-shaped beach with quite strong waves.  Nice to see the outdoor gym where the men were soaking in the rays while working out.  A nice-to-see on my list.

reviews.title: Suprising small
reviews.text: As one of the most famous, at least outwardly, beaches in australia i was expecting to be blown away; and while it was a very nice beach, clean and with lots of people for a fall day, i was also really smaill i walked the entire strech, including the lookout cliffs in 40 mins

reviews.title: Walking around
reviews.text: Great beach to walk around, a lot of tourist though but still worth to go. Wonderful restaurants along the corner. Must see

reviews.title: Best Beach
reviews.text: It may be overrated to some. But trust me you'll be in awe when u see the clear turquoise blue sea and the fine smooth sands. Cos its winter the beach wasn't crowded. U could do picnic at the grass patch watch surfers do their stunts. Besides spending your day at the beach. Trek a little to the top to have a spectacular view of the beach and sea! Its absolutely amazing.

reviews.title: Nice beach, views and restaurants, be careful of the water!!
reviews.text: Coming from Adelaide, South Australia, this was my first time to Bondi Beach and was happy to find it was actually quite peaceful during August. There were plenty of cafes with a variety of food available, not so much on the esplanade but still worth visiting. As a fairly experienced open-water swimmer (no surf-life saving experience however), I was surprised at how strong and powerful the waves and currents were and I got dumped heavily on my head while body surfing the waves, this happened between the red and yellow flags! So if you are not a competent swimmer I would recommend to be VERY careful in the water and DEFINITELY swim between the flags!

reviews.title: Beautiful beach but as per locals.. GO TO MANLY BEACH
reviews.text: We went looking to experience the hype... well thats where it fell flat. Great beach ummm but thats all it really is. Maybe because where we come from we blessed with many great beaches. Found it overcrowded and really not.that.great. Shouldve listened to the MANY locals that tried to convince us to go to Manly Beach. Sadly we already booked a few things we couldnt cancel. Should've listened...

reviews.title: Nice Beach
reviews.text: Bondi Beach is a nice , clean beach, easily accessible by public transport, however we had driven down in our rented car.It has some nice cafes nearby. It’s a great place to spend some time. It wasn’t very crowded in August. But I have seen better beaches, and after all the hype, was a tad disappointed

reviews.title: Relaxing half day trip
reviews.text: Bondi Beach deserves all the accolades showered on it ever since I can remember. Great surfs, fine sands, good restaurants nearby. When I was there in August, it was not crowded. Sydney’s mild winter makes it a lovely time to visit and chill, in my opinion. We did not swim, but could play in the water.To get to Bondi, we chose to take a ferry from Circular Quay, Pier 2, to Watson’s Bay (explored the Gap when we were there) and from there took bus 380 to Bondi. For the return trip to the city, we took bus 333, a 40-minute bus ride. All the trips were paid using the Opal card. It was a great half-day trip.

reviews.title: Pretty but very crowded!
reviews.text: It was great to go to Bondi Beach and experience this beach, but there are much better beaches that don’t have as many people. It was so so crowded when we went.

reviews.title: Best Attraction of Sydney
reviews.text: We rent a car from Easyrentcars.com and drove to Bondi. It's the best beach ever seen. Worth the road trip.

reviews.title: Surfer’s Paradise
reviews.text: Visited Bondi and this is indeed a good place to enjoy sun and beach, especially to surfers. Lots of cafe’s and food options in the area. A good view can be witnessed on the rocky part of north bondi. Must visit if you are in Sydney.

reviews.title: Good transport links
reviews.text: We took the bus from the city suburbs to Bondi beach. It's a very commercial main street with all the fast food chains like McDonalds and beach stores selling clothes and sun cream etc. The area is a crescent shape around the bay and the shops and main road follow that shape.   Lots and lots of young people  fill the area for the beach scene and surfing.   It's quite a meeting point for young people.There were no waves the day we were there.It reminds me of Newquay in the UK ...... very similar indeed.Great to visit and tuck off the bucket list.

reviews.title: Surf Beach, street art and pavilion
reviews.text: I came early morning - on my way to get coffee. The people here right now would be die hard Bondi Beach goers. It’s in the middle of winter here, sunny, but cold. More than 50 surfers on the water, and many others walking on the beach. This is an iconic place - beyond the hype there is a serene tranquility to this place. From the surfers, to the dog walkers, to this who are just walking, relaxing, and talking. Morning rituals. Afternoon excitement. Evening spectacle. Bondi beach is a must-see attraction when visiting SYDNEY.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: The beach is beautiful, and please go to see the infinity pool at the south side. But its clear this is the place where most tourists and backpackers go to, as the bars/restaurants along the boulevard are a bit on the lower segment, with lots of home- or pennyless people hanging around.

reviews.title: Wow
reviews.text: The best beach at all! Do not miss!!!! We arrive by bus 374. Nice walk on the rocks. A little bit windy.

reviews.title: Impressive
reviews.text: Great waves, clean air, nice sand, but if you are going to swimm take every warning seriously, because waves are very strong. Lufe guards are very effective in warning people to be safe.

reviews.title: Not the best
reviews.text: This beach is very famous! But is not the best around Sydney. Just to spend a different day. I suggest to ho with friends.

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: The beach is great, albeit crowded. The town surrounding it is dirty and rowdy, and selling chep touristy merch.

reviews.title: Fantastic day out
reviews.text: Had a fantastic day, walking round the area, great fish and chips in the traditional chip shop , would recommend to anyone visiting the beach to stop by for great food, the beach was incredible and clean

reviews.title: Amazing as ever
reviews.text: Great walks  scenery and places to eat.  However  would say it can get busy. The beach is amazing with beautiful  views.

reviews.title: Good, but ...
reviews.text: Firstly, beware the naming of 'Bondi Junction' station. It really is a good 40mins walk from the station to the beach and the station itself is below a shopping centre (what everyone would go to Bondi for, right?). That said, you can still use the Sydney city bus tickets in the area and some of the buses will take you back to Circular Quay.As for Bondi itself, it's a lovely beach with good amenities, lots of people and a friendly atmosphere. I wasn't there at the height of summer, so I may have seen it when it was a bit less packed than normal ... yet, it was still busy!But ... it is only a beach. Once you have got over standing on the famous Bondi beach, that really is about it. There are great walks to be had, especially to the south, which make you realise that there are better beaches close by. Worth going to, but once you've been there, you've been there.

reviews.title: Stunning beach and surrounding coastal walk
reviews.text: It's famous for a reason, because it's beautiful!  Even in the winter time you can catch some hits of warm sun so definitely visit!  Surfers are out every day, and the surrounding coastal walk, restaurants, park, and town are a GREAT way to spend a few hours (or more) in Sydney.  I came from Circular Quay, took the train (for the first time) and it was pretty easy.  Just buy an OPAL card, the trip is like $3 all told.  You have to switch one time, then get off at Bondi Junction.  From there grab a cab to the beach (too far to walk).  Have lunch, watch the surfers, do the coastal walk (another must do), watch kids in the skate park, walk on the beach, check out the waves crashing into the Iceberg swim club (to the right of the beach), and have an awesome time at this spectacular beach. Place must be insane in the summer.  Will definitely come back!

reviews.title: Beautiful day at Bondi
reviews.text: Always a great place to visit so long as there isn’t too many tourists around. Stunning beach and water

reviews.title: Nice but nothing special
reviews.text: We took the Uber to Bondi from Circular Quay. A great way to get there fast! We spent some time on the beach and watched the surfers. After the sun went down we walked in Bondi for a bit but since it is winter we found it a little bit slow.

reviews.title: One of those places you just have to go!
reviews.text: Bondi was WONDERFUL! There are tons of people laying out, surfing, walking, running, playing games, you name it and it's here!Our favorite part was the murals where we had a miniature photoshoot, so awesome!

reviews.title: Great Beach
reviews.text: We visited on a rather cold & windy day, so accept we didn’t see Bondi Beach at its beast – although I have visited in the summer (39 years ago) – the sand is beautiful, golden & soft and importantly clean & litter free. As out of season visitor numbers understandably low but still a good number of surfers braving the cold – as was the odd intrepid swimmer or two – far braver than us! Definitely a place to visit to tick off the “Bucket List”, I’m sure in the height of the season there will be quieter less busy beaches & coves to be found for those in the know. However, I would definitely recommend a visit.

reviews.title: Surfer's paradise perhaps
reviews.text: Our visit was during winter time in July, not much people but can feel if during summer it should be crowded. Easily to travel by taking 333 bus from circular quay.

reviews.title: Bondi Beach
reviews.text: This is a beautiful well known beach 8km from Sydney. The beach and views are beautiful. Definitely worth a visit.

reviews.title: Great beach, plenty to see and do
reviews.text: There are probably many more beautiful beaches in Australia but to step onto Bondi Beach and soak in the atmosphere has to be a highlight of a trip to Sydney. Take some photos, have a snack or drink in one of the many cafes/bars to suit all tastes and budgets.

reviews.title: Surfer’s beach
reviews.text: Not a place to swim properly, as you can in other different beaches. Good to surf and enjoy it from the sand and the surroundings.

reviews.title: Very nice beach
reviews.text: We went there in winter but it was sunny nice day. The beach is beautiful white sandy. There are lots of resraurants. Also can easily change in the bathroom and provides lockers. Along the beach, tgere are lots of beautiful street arts

reviews.title: Exhilarating
reviews.text: After lunch nearby, we decided to spin by Bondi Beach as the weather was nice. As it was winter time, there weren't too many people swimming but there were still lots of people at Bondi- walking, sipping coffee, enjoying the breeze. Still a great way to cap an afternoon . And it's free!

reviews.title: Nice place to spend some time!
reviews.text: Beautiful scenic view: checkGo surfing: checkFood options for meals: checkSecluded spots for romantic times: checkClothing optional: checkSpacious lawn to lay down: checkAll in all a great spot to visit and spend some quality time in Sydney. Well connected with public transport.

reviews.title: Go for the Coastal Walk, otherwise Manly is Better
reviews.text: This beach is great, and it’s the beginning of the coastal walk that travels through Tamarama, Bronte, and Coogee beaches. If you go to do the walk it’s totally worth it. There are small surf shops and plenty of lunch/dinner joints with great beach views. If you’re planing a full day at the beach, I prefer Manly beach. It has more shops/restaurants and it’s just bigger so you can spread out more. Plus the ferries take you straight to Manly where as you have to connect into Bondi.

reviews.title: A wonder down under
reviews.text: The world renowned Bondi Beach is a truly iconic.  The sand is fine, and silky.  Swimmers, and surfers share waves.  I recommend public transportation, as parking is limited.  Restaurants and coffee shops are within walking distance.  People from near and far visit the numerous public events held year round.  A playground area for kids, a public pool, and community room are within the beach confines. There are a number of shops nearby to purchase a souvenir or two.

reviews.title: Bondi Beach
reviews.text: Absolutely awesome to visit one of Australia's biggest icons. Especially the Iceberg Pools overlooking the ocean . I visited in April this year but it was a very nice day a top of 27 degrees Celsius and I especially loved the street art along the beach.

reviews.title: Lovely
reviews.text: Beautiful, clean, and I could sit all day, people watching, there are all the services from buses,taxis, plus shops, restaurants etc. The beach it self was lovely and clean, and well look after with the life guards on patrol 24/7. Great for families.

reviews.title: Winter @ Bondi Beach
reviews.text: I thought visiting in winter will be fewer people and I am wrong. There are still a lot of beachgoers and surfers while the Sun is up. Parking is always full, be prepared to park a few streets away. I will always try to drive along the beach to look for parking.They are smart by organising activities during wintertime. They have ice skating, and ferry wheels cater tourist like us who don't want to swim in winter. The view of Bondi beach/sea is fantastic and multimillions dollars property seat along the horizon. There are shopping and restaurants across the road.

reviews.title: Not impressed
reviews.text: Not sure about the rave of this place.  Maybe I'm not a surfer. Just a beach and not very long stretch.

reviews.title: Popular beach for people watching
reviews.text: We made a quick photo stop and had a quick stroll along the beach. The beach seemed to be clean and was not too crowded on a weekday. There is no shade on the beach, a sun umbrella will be needed for an extended stay.

reviews.title: 1st Visit to Bondi Beach, Australia
reviews.text: Train and bus guides thru the internet were of great help.  Brought my  rubber slippers, which I eventually tossed in my bag, because walking barefoot on the white sand beach is relaxing.  Skating rink was just for merry-go-skiing due to limited space. Grumpy resto, just a few steps away from the shore, offering a glass of wine per pizza or pasta was a good deal.

reviews.title: One of many beaches in Australia
reviews.text: One of many beaches in Australia. It's a little crowded there, especially during summer. Manly beach is much more quiet.

reviews.title: Amazing Beach
reviews.text: We stopped here on a tour for about an hour and ended up deciding we needed to come back the next day.  We came back by bus the following day, which was surprisingly easy from our hotel.  We rented a towels, chairs and an umbrella from a stand on the beach. The rays are STRONG here so wear extra SPF and re-apply way more often than you normally would.  The beach wasn't too crowded, but it was windy.  It was a great relaxed day at the beach and would definitely recommend!

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: I finally got the chance to visit this beach after seeing it on TV and shows all the time. Love the unique street art they display on the walls - adds a hip vibe to this iconic beach. I went during winter and it was still nice enough to take a leisurely stroll.

reviews.title: Day Visit
reviews.text: Bondi is a beautiful beach even in winter. Lots of people walking around enjoying life. Lots of things to see and do around Bondi.

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: Bondi beach is lovely and well worth a visit. It is not as big as I thought it would be. There are a few shops and cafes too. The beach was lovely and clean and there are plenty of benches you can sit on to enjoy the views.

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: Great attraction! We took the underground to Bondi Junction and the bus from there! It’s beautiful if you just want to eat and walk around or if you really want to surf! Amazing environment great place!

reviews.title: Small But Beautifully Formed
reviews.text: Bondi Beach is a lot smaller than I thought, both ends blocked off by outcrops as opposed to the miles of golden sand I expected. Still very nice though. I was only there for a couple of hours (a stop on the hop-on hop-off bus which is a convenient way to see it) in "winter" (about 22 degrees) but there was a nice vibe to the area.

reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text: Bondi beach is famous and it sure has reasons. Crystal clear waters and a magnificent view. A must visit.

reviews.title: My Favourite Beach
reviews.text: I absolutely loved the time I spent at Bondi Beach. The beach is so beautiful with pristine water. I was lucky that I went on a weekday so it wasn't as busy. Perfect place to sit and relax. When I came back a second time I spent time exploring the parks and view points to the north and south of the beach. Definitely recommend a trip to the Icebergs Club to have a drink on the terrace!

reviews.title: Second time better than the first.
reviews.text: My initial visit to the Bondi Beach was underwhelming and disappointing, as it was with a bus tour in the cold rain.I decided to give it another try on my last day in Sydney.  It was the Queen's Birthday Holiday and the weather was beautiful(for the beginning of Winter) , giving me an opportunity to experience all of the hype that I've heard about Bondi Beach.  There were picnics, barbecue and music on the grassy knolls, skaters, volleyball and street art in another section, surfers at sea and sunbathers sprinkled all over the place.  The water was warm,  the sand/beach was clean and the vibe was super chill. Plenty of restaurants and shops surrounding the area.  It was a great way to spend my last evening in Sydney.  Can't wait to return.

reviews.title: Great beach, especially at sunset
reviews.text: It’s a really great beach. Perfect for us kids, tho waves are really big so parents, always keep watch. Other than that, it’s really great. Unfortunately, I didn’t get to take photos as I was having too much fun. Also, there are murals there that are really nice.

reviews.title: Beachgoers delight
reviews.text: If you do nothing else, jump on the Hop on-Hop off bus and make a stop here.  Even if you don't plan to go on the beach it is a very large park area and although quite busy it does not detract from the ambiance of the area.  Many small shops and dining establishments (both local and large franchises) are located on the walkway along with a variety of clothing and other shopping options.  Even if you don't dip in the ocean, it is a great place to people-watch and view the beach and surrounding area.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach But Busy
reviews.text: We visited Bondi Beach as part of a day trip to see the Sunday markets and then walk the coastal walk. The markets were nice- crafty and we then walked past the shops lining  the main road before walking along the grassy promenade and up past the pool. Nice views of the sweeping beach and lots of room despite it being busy.

reviews.title: Loved it. Wish we could surf
reviews.text: We loved our visit to Bondi Beach. The sand and surrounding area was spotless and there were more than adequate places to eat drink or just watch the waves roll in with surfers on top.We took the bus from Circular Quay and 45 minutes later we were at Bondi. The beach was not as long as we imagined but we loved our visit there and wished that we could surf to take full advantage.

reviews.title: phew!
reviews.text: this is a must visit place... the atmosphere is charged up... there's surfers, swimmers, and people just out for a picnic!

reviews.title: Don’t have too high of expectations
reviews.text: It’s a great place for sunset and viewing the iceberg pools, but wasn’t amazing. It’s a nice beach..

reviews.title: Christmas Day on Bondi Beach
reviews.text: Definitely a tradition for many to go to Bondi Beach on Christmas Day. The beach was crowded with locals and visitors alike, but we expected it to be. Lots of people in red Santa hats. No surf rentals today and many shops were closed, as well. But, overall still a great day to enjoy the sun, sand, and sea! We took the city bus from our hotel in Sydney CBD. Make sure you buy an "Opal" bus card for visitors at a convenience store because they don't sell tickets on the bus.

reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text: I never expect a park and beach that is so well maintained, clean and well facilited for visitors. Love the grass field and seating area, everyone enjoying the sea view and hang out at the park, so relaxing.

reviews.title: Pristine sand!
reviews.text: We had a half day tour of Sydney and its suburbs leading to the Bondi beach. The beach was pristine with the white soft sand totally taking the cake. There are a lot of shops along the beach for eating and shopping. We had not packed shorts for the boys so wanted to buy some there but nothing was available for the older one (9 years). There were some for the younger one (6 yrs) but they were super expensive. We ended up just having ice cream and leaving. All in all a buzzing place with lots of people surfing and generally sitting or walking etc..

reviews.title: Nice Place to Visit
reviews.text: If you’ve watched the show Bondi Rescue, you may as well check out the place the show is filmed! Beautiful beach, plenty to check out around it including some awesome artwork and not too hard to get to. But seriously, if you can’t swim, stay out of the water, it’s easy to see how people get themselves into trouble so easily when you visit the beach and ignore the lifeguards signage and warnings. Stay safe and enjoy!

reviews.title: Good beach
reviews.text: Looks like a great area to living right next to the beach. Have a lot of restaurants and cafes nearby  but they can Be expensive

reviews.title: Use as a start point for coastal walk
reviews.text: Bondi is a nice beach but there are many better beaches to spend a day at in Sydney. Use Bondi as a starting point for the coastal walk to Coogee beach. Transport tip: Try and get the bus from the city to Bondi, this will be the easiest way. Avoid the train to Bondi Junction- this is a lot further away from the beach than you would expect, you’ll still have to get another bus which you’ll have to queue for ages for and will be packed before it picks you up.

reviews.title: Big Beach
reviews.text: This is a very large beach and an icon for Australia.  Lots of folks enjoying the outdoors and hopefully you will see a lot of expert surfers.  Places to eat.

reviews.title: Great beach for tourist
reviews.text: Be prepared for the high volumes of people visiting the beach. It is a pretty large beach with a good number of bars and restaurants around for good drinks and eats. This is a good beach to visit when it comes to outsiders not familiar with Australian beaches. There are other beaches to go to however if you want something simple and easy Bondi beach is the place to be. There's even a skatepark for advanced and amateur skaters.

reviews.title: Bondi Beach
reviews.text: This is a very nice and beautiful sandy beach.  There are plenty of shops and places to eat and get ice cream.   They also have a place to clean off from the wonderful beach activities with toilets and showers.

reviews.title: Overrated
reviews.text: By all means, visit Bondi to experience this iconic piece of Australian culture. However there are better beaches in the area and without the volumes of people.

reviews.title: Don’t Miss
reviews.text: I was in Sydney and on my last day went to Bondi. At first I was hesitant because people had told me it was trashy. Glad I did not listen. I did the Coastal Walk which was breathtaking. Please don’t miss this. On the walk which is about 2 miles are cliffs, beaches and surfers. On the way back I ate in.Bondi Iceberg.It is right on the water overlooking an infinity pool, cliffs and the beach. What a perfect way to end my trip to down under.

reviews.title: Beautiful Bondi Beach
reviews.text: I found Bondi Beach to be what I expected—a beautiful beach with lots of surfers. I saw one or two surf schools along with solo surfers and groups of surfers. They were fun to watch. I got a coffee and sat near the sand to people-watch, and it was a beautiful way to spend a morning.

reviews.title: Bondi Beach Boardwalk
reviews.text: The boardwalk on Bondi Beach is very dog friendly. Dogs cannot go on the beach but a lot of shops and restaurants have food and water dishes out for dogs. It was great.

reviews.title: Sweet beach
reviews.text: Loved it here! It's very friendly, good amount of people, loads of cafe, ice cream, restaurants, dogs. Direct bus in to the city to the beach. Half way from Westfield shopping centre. Lovely area, clean beach :)

reviews.title: Amazing beach!
reviews.text: We visited Bondi Beach on a warm day and it slowly began to flow with people. The beach is beautiful and is manned by professional lifeguards. The strip of shops near the beach offer local shopping and opportunities to eat. Toilets and lockers are also available. The Bondi Icebergs Club to the side of the beach is also great for swimming.

reviews.title: Sydney visit
reviews.text: Spectacular day, clean beach, lifeguards and a busy beach. A typical Bondi beach day. We wondered the esplanade and took in the sights.

reviews.title: A beautiful beach
reviews.text: My wife and I spent just part of an afternoon at this iconic Australian beach. It was May, so the beach was hardly bustling with activity but there was enough going on to pique our interest, mostly surfing activity.The beach is remarkably clean. We had a quick fish and chips and beer at Lush on Bondi. The food was great but the ‘music’ was too loud and inappropriate for family dining. We actually walked past and checked out the other options because of the noise but decided Lush was the best choice in spite of it. We certainly could have enjoyed a whole day at the beach. Had I brought the appropriate gear and had the time, I would have taken a dip.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach in Sydney
reviews.text: This place is a very good place to hangout and chill. Loved it. There are plenty of place to eat as well.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach in the suburbs of Sydney. Prestine and beautiful, nice for a stroll even along the shore and taking in the breathtaking views from Bondi.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Amazing beach and town. Plenty to see, eat, and do. Make sure you make it to the market if it is open while you are visiting. The iceberg pool is also a must see and great place for a drink overlooking the pool and ocean.

reviews.title: Bondi to Coogee Beach Coastal Walk - A walk well worth taking!
reviews.text: This is a beautiful walk and well worth taking if you are able to do so. Bondi Beach itself is amazing. No wonder it is a world-famous beach. We watched many young people learning to surf the waves while children played in the water. The walk from the main beach to the lookout point (going past the Icebergs Ocean Pool where there is also a dining room & bar), also has many photo opportunities along the way. This walking trail seems to end just past the lookout point. However, go online to get the complete circular trail that takes you back to your starting point. Time well spent.

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: With their famous name, some people say, you would never come to sydney if you dont ever visited Bondi Beach. White sands, nice view could make feel release and relax enjoying the sourrounding. Would be great if they add some souvenirs store with lower price at Bondi Pavillion

reviews.title: It was a good day to visit this beach.
reviews.text: We were thankful that it was sunny enough to visit Bondi Beach. It was warm enough. Upon arriving, my Better Half and I marvelled at the smoothness of the sand, the strong winds, and the people enjoying the surfing. This is a good place to be when it is hot and sunny and you’d like to go for a swim. This is our first visit to Bondi Beach and we were thankful to take lots of pictures and videos of such a gorgeous place!

reviews.title: Manly Beach > Bondi Beach
reviews.text: We used our Opal cards to get the bus to Bondi Beach. This was very easy. Once arriving at Bondi Beach there are plenty of shops around the town, you can visit the swimming pool or the beach. If I’m honest Bondi Beach is a bit of a tourist trap. I preferred visiting Manly as there were less crowds and I thought the town and beach was nicer. There is also more to do in Manly e.g walks.

reviews.title: Amazing place
reviews.text: So beautiful, easy to get to from city center and getting there by Big Bus was 30 mins. Enjoyed strolling the beach on a beautiful Saturday and grabbing lunch before heading back. A fantastic place to relax and unwind.

reviews.title: Bondi Beach
reviews.text: This is a must place to visit!!  Ps don’t forget your swim suit!  We planed on staying on the beach just a short time but it was sooo cool we spent several hrs.  The beach was awesome the water amazing.  Truly cool shopping cool stores right off the beach.  Please if you visit in AUSTRALIA please go to Bondi you will always remember this beach...

reviews.title: Cooler beach
reviews.text: Its autumn, if you prepare ur thongs and thinking lying on hot sunny beach for tanning then u r coming in a wrong time. Its freezing n windy....dont get me wrong....the beach is beautiful n clean....its just we came in wrong season...i guess

reviews.title: Better than expected!
reviews.text: Fantastic beach with so much to do and great places to stay. We rented an apartment just a block from the beach, but there are plenty of hostels and other places to stay as well. Tons of shopping, restaurants, and other amenities to meet anyone’s needs.

reviews.title: A beach worth visiting!
reviews.text: The beach itself is amazing but more then that there are amazing walks that are stunning. I would recommend the walk bondi to bronte but if you are looking for something lower key and less tourists you can try coogie beach which is about a 5 min drive away also really nice.

reviews.title: Big waves💕
reviews.text: Thrilled to walk on this fabulous white sandy beach and watch the waves.  Clean change rooms and gift shops very close by.

reviews.title: It's a Beach
reviews.text: Nothing much to shout about. No Pamela Anderson. In fact nothing really here at all. Some surf for the surfer. But not much else. Water was ok, but not really suited for families with young children. Disappointing. Restaurants, not great either. Maybe just out of season. But generally area looked dated.Coogee beach on the other hand. Much nicer.

reviews.title: A morning stop
reviews.text: This hopping place had many people out enjoying the day.  The views were nice and there are plenty of activities and not as you like.  Park and enjoy!

reviews.title: A good place to relax and eat
reviews.text: If you enjoy the busy beach then this is the place for you! It seems pretty safe, the sand very soft! Heaps of places for you to buy souvenirs, eat or drink.

reviews.title: Plenty food and sun
reviews.text: Great place for a sunny day. A lot of sun, water and little shops to buy your lunch. Nice boardwalk along the beach. Gorgeous place - a must visit while in Sydney. Use hop on-off bus, blue line to take you there.

reviews.title: lives up to the hype
reviews.text: this was part of our bus tour. coming down the hill into bondi and you can see how pretty it is. of course it was crowded but it doesnt take away from the beauty of the area. lots of cafes everywhere.

reviews.title: Wow !
reviews.text: Fantastic Anzac Day spent laying on beach and swimming. Great cafes around, lots of lifeguards around including the boys on Bondi Rescue. Unfortunately Icebergs pool was closed maybe for maintenance ? Deck lounges and umbrellas available for hire on beach. Worth a visit !

reviews.title: Nice but,
reviews.text: Yes it is with Manly the nearest beach from Sydney but it is crowded.Manly is mich bigger but you will have to go by ferry so.... Bonny is reachable by bus.Nice and regular surfing waves. Good surfing schools and junk food. But the city has no interest and the parking is dreadfully expensive. You will feel secured with the life saving guards. Nice hôtel and salted swimming pool.

reviews.title: Iconic Beach
reviews.text: Bondi Beach is a must do for everyone visiting Sydney. Such an iconic beach and also take a dip in icebergs pool a short walk along the beach. The eateries across the road are amazing as well.

reviews.title: Surfing.....
reviews.text: I don't know how to put it there is something between me and surfing. It's a beautiful place to go to. Look at.and wonderful place to surf.surrounded by good number of surfing shop,souvenirs shops,clothes,food,wine what not.We had a great time because it just drizzled for a while and the skies cleared just before we started swimming....I hate to say this it would be injustice if I don't give a honest option  so here hear... the beach is well maintained,space for working out, very active life guarded very safe but the trash cans gave an awful stench for quite a distance.

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: We visited on a quiet afternoon.  The beach is lovely but can get busy with surfers. It's a nice walk along the sand and had a promenade where you can sit and have a drink/food.

reviews.title: Just ordinary
reviews.text: It is a small beach but close to city makes a good place for many people.Though it attracts large number of tourists,  may be it should improve on drug control and vaping.

reviews.title: Short trip
reviews.text: Had to tread foot in the world famous Bondi Beach 🏖 on our visit the wind was crazy so we ere unable to stay on the beach for long, the waves we’re great though, a wonderful bay worth the visit.

reviews.title: A must do for an undying experinence of Sydney.
reviews.text: Vast stretches of sand and sea with perfect views of the wave catching surfboarders can never be explained but with Bondi. The rock pool is so exciting and the cliff around is fabulous during sunrise and sunset. The surrounding parade is perfect for shopping and the restaurants are classy.

reviews.title: Great surfing
reviews.text: The beach is wide and despite a lot of people it never seemed too crowded. It’s such a fun and laid back beach community. Food is closes by and you can spend the day chilling.

reviews.title: Spectacular
reviews.text: What a spectacular place, pictures don’t do it justice, sit by the water have someFish and chips or walk along the beach front, either way you’ll love it. Parking is very expensive right on the water so I suggest finding somewhere close by if you don’t mind a little walking

reviews.title: Way better than expected
reviews.text: We came out to Bondi on the Big Bus trip, and it was well worth it. Gorgeous sand, idyllic setting, loads of shops (not sure what they all sell as we didn't go in) and some great places to eat. Very much an unexpected highlight

reviews.title: Bondi stopover
reviews.text: I have been to Bondi three times before in my visits to Sydney. This time by courtesy of a driver excursion who knew area well. This was also my best visit to Bondi. Beach was fairly full due to Easter holidays and great views seen of whole area. Everybody knows Bondi get yourself there

reviews.title: No bondi lifeguards but still great scenery
reviews.text: Arrived on a beauty winters day.  Was windy but very sunny and just beautiful.  Walked round the headland  to Bronte beech and what a great walk.  Saw dolphins in the distance.  A great walk.

reviews.title: Crazy busy, bustling beach.
reviews.text: So spectacular beach, Sandy, great swimming, unbelievable views.  Not a 5 for me because it is so busy... it is truly crazy.  If you are in your late teens, early twenties this is the place to be.

reviews.title: Bondi
reviews.text: The most touristic and crowded beach of Sydney East and one of the most beautiful when there is no one around. Surfing is awesome in winter or with dangerous conditions and horrible in summer. There are probably as many surfers on the wave as towels on the beach. Anyway, everybody loves Bondi.

reviews.title: BEACH
reviews.text: This is a MUST to visit when visiting Sydney. You just need to feel the waves and ride them. Very nice surroundings with nice restaurants and surf shops....a place to relax and just enjoy

reviews.title: 40 minutes from city center
reviews.text: You will find the iconic beach of Bondi.  Enjoy a swim between the flags or view the ocean club pool on the waters edge.  Good restaurants and shopping along the main road.

reviews.title: Iconic Beach that is a must to visit
reviews.text: A great Beach that is smaller than I imagined and in the height of the season could be very crowded. A great selection of bars and restaurants and an atmosphere one would expect in this Iconic place. Close to Sydney so worth a bus ride.

reviews.title: Bondi Beach Food Markets on Saturday mornings
reviews.text: Do not miss out on this amazing food experience.  Saturday mornings at Bondi Beach Public School there are many food stalls, fresh vegetables, butchers, flowers etc.  My favourite breakfast is the corn fritter stall who pile up your plate with the most delicious food.  2nd choice is the falafel stall.  Everyone then sits on the oval enjoying their feasts and contributing to the amazing community feel of the event.

reviews.title: Nice Beach yes, but slightly overhyped, expansive and crowded
reviews.text: Yes, it is a nice beach, it is a "must see" in Sydney, is located "in" the city, which is pretty cool. But from my point of view and compared to what i had heard before this beach was a bit of a let down as it was not as iconic as it is advertised. The shops / restaurants around the area are way overpriced (Sydney is an expansive place anyway, but here i paid +30$ for 4 soft drinks - in a supermarket) and the tourists are more than willing to pay. Crowds of selfie-tourists spoil the scene, i didn´t feel the desire to stay longer than a few minutes here. Instead I highly recommend the smaller and less visited beaches along the Bondi-Coogee walk, like my favourites Tamarama and Coogee Beach, and Bronte Beach as well. If you are more into privacy, great swims, natural / scenic landscapes and nature, then take an extra walk of only a few minutes south of Bondi.

reviews.title: Beautiful place for a sunset
reviews.text: Walk down to the beach or down on to the rocks, beautiful place, lots of parking, public toilets available, bars and restaurants near by

reviews.title: The  water is chilly out of season but a great place to  walk and unwind.
reviews.text: This iconic beach has 2 very different faces – teeming with people on the sand and in the water during Australian summer but virtually abandoned in winter and only a few walkers and surfers to be seen. The  water is chilly out of season but a great place to  walk or relax. No problem finding places serving food or coffee – many restaurants, takeaway places, and shops at Bondi. The Bondi-Coogee coastal walk is refreshing in the cooler weather and there is a swimming pool located to the side where you can swim there for reduced price. For us Bondi Beach (what a great name) was a must see but we found it was a bit smaller than imagined - also glad it is close to Sydney and its attractions.

reviews.title: Impressive beach
reviews.text: We were there in late April and very few people were swimming (I guess the place is overcrowded in summer time). The whole area is clean and a beer in the Pavilion is very refreshing.

reviews.title: A must
reviews.text: Took the blue route on Big Bus Tour and hopped off at Bondi for a few hours - the beach is fab., clean and water quality great. Walked the Bondi to Coogee Coastal Walk and what spectacular views of the many beaches along the walk - something you have to do if in Sydney.

reviews.title: Holiday
reviews.text: Very good place to visit. Good location. Lots of things to do and see. Good food and good cafes. Close to public transport..

reviews.title: I was disappointed
reviews.text: After all the hype about Bondi beach I was expecting something quite spectacular. It was quite small and virtually no one was surfing. There was an art display at Bondi pavilion but nothing much happening.

reviews.title: Not that Special
reviews.text: Made the trip via public transport from City, fairly straight forward but involves train trip then jumping on buses to get to Bondi. Nothing quite like being packed on a bus like a sardine. As for the beach, well yes it's pretty. But wow, tourists outnumber the locals it appears. All eateries were packed and had considerable cues & naturally argumentative customers were prolific. To be honest we we're glad to get out of there and back to the City. To be honest, much nicer beaches to visit.

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: I enjoyed my visit to Bondi beach, but found the area to be heavily commercialized.  I had hoped for a less populated experience.

reviews.title: Went on a nice hot day and enjoyed
reviews.text: Excellent beach with great views. Definitely lived up to the hype. It was only a half hour from where I stayed. Excellent food along the beach area with places to shop too.

reviews.title: Bondi Beach or Bust!
reviews.text: If you go to Sydney. You go to the famous Bondi Beach. The day I visited the weather was perfect. Mid week kept the crowds down so people watching was minimal. The surf was small at 1-2'. Anyone can rent a surfboard. I didn't. The actual beach length is smaller than I expected but overall is a great beach. Plenty of food options and they have a rather large selection of the typical tourist shops directly across the street from the beach.

reviews.title: Maybe we just caught it on an off-day
reviews.text: Well, the rain most certainly did not help.  But it was still possible to see the sand, ocean, waves, and amenities that Bondi Beach had to offer.  And a really big pool.  And sharks.  Australia has its share, and them some, of our finned friends.It's human nature to make the best with what you have and this beach is pretty much just about the best (or nearly so) that Sydney has.  The Beach does have shark nets and, that all by itself, would keep my feet firmly planted on the sand.  We lived in California and we go to Maui, so we have been to many beaches where they also have sharks.  But just not so many and there aren't shark nets.  And just how effective are they anyway?  The skippers on the tour boats say they don't swim in the ocean.  These are the guys in the know; who is going to argue with the voice of experience?  But it is a popular draw, this Bondi Beach.  Make good use of the resources you have and enjoy them as best you can.

reviews.title: Don’t Bother
reviews.text: A beautiful beach with fine sand, where families seem to gather on the weekend to sun and surf. It’s like any famous beach and coming from California, U.S.A, I would pick something else to do.

reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: After all the hype we wanted to see what this famous beach had to offer, when we arrived we were so disappointed, it's appears to be right next to a housing estate, the beach isn't that big and it was crowded. We turned around and went back to Sydney.

reviews.title: Wonderful iconic beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach - unmissable.  While you're there, do take a surfing lesson from Let's Go Surfing - they do a really good job of getting you up on your feet but also teach you about rip tides and how to carry your board without being hit in the face on the way in to the sea! For a great view of the beach with a drink or a meal, go to the RSL (Returned Servicemen's League) at  the North end of the beach (upstairs - downstairs is a different establishment).

reviews.title: Surfers Paradise
reviews.text: One of the most iconic beaches not only in Australia but in the world.. from surfers to hardy swimmers tackle the waves while sun seekers enjoy the sweeping sands.If the waves prove to be powerful or looks daunting then stick to the Icebergs outdoor pool which is stunning and is surrounded by the sea..The beach is also part of a coastal walk with stunning views and crashing waves on the mountains. With plenty of pubs, bars and restaurants to choose from. The beach itself is a 10 minute bus ride from Bondi Junction station. All good for families, backpackers to couples.Thanks

reviews.title: Good for a relaxing stroll
reviews.text: I was here during the Australian winter, so the usual crowds were gone - and it turned out to be perfect. The hour-long stroll was quiet and relaxing, and the view was not bad as well. Public facilities abound, and there's great coffee a few steps away!

reviews.title: My favorite surf beach in Sydney because it is easily accessible and safe
reviews.text: Bondi o my fav surf beach in Sydney.  We know we’re tomalways get a free park a 10 minute walk to the beach.  Living I. Surry Hills, I sometimes jump on the 333 Express bus to Bondi.  It only take a about 20 minutes.  I prefer North Bondi where the crowd is a bit more manageable.  There are places to get sandwiches and drinks not too far from the beach.  It is always clean and people seem quite respectful of the beach at a Roth Bondi.  My favorite bay beach is Shelly Beach at Manly.  It is beautiful!

reviews.title: Iconic beach
reviews.text: Been here many times, but there's no better view on a sunny day , so much to see lots of cafes , restaurants , shops to explore ,markets on weekends , walk along costs you nothing to enjoy the view,  have a dip or just watch  the surf and admire plenty of buses from city, start the walk along the coast from here, which goes from right of beach, call into ice bergs for a drink or meal lovely views from there.just come you wont be disappointed.

reviews.title: Sand and Surfers
reviews.text: A sunny day to visit Bondi Beach.  Even with a chill in the air there were plenty of people out enjoying the water.

reviews.title: Vibrant and lively beach
reviews.text: I loved bondi beach! The vibe is definitely friendly and stylish, it attracts the most beautiful people and provides glorious waves for surfers. Lots of shops. Restaurants and bars around.

reviews.title: Beach for the Teens and the 20’s
reviews.text: Everyone is welcome in this beach but predominantly young adults to 20’s.Some rentals for chairs available and public bathroom offers shower.

reviews.title: Awesome beach
reviews.text: Easy access by local bus service. Clean beach with soft sand! There are many shops to visit along the beach too!

reviews.title: Great views
reviews.text: Well everyone has heard of this place so had to see it. Nice to walk along the beach and watch the surfers.

reviews.title: Best beach
reviews.text: No seaweed. No sea shells. No rocks. Lots of fun waves. Beautiful sand. Chill atmosphere. Lots of local shopping and cuisine. Just a beautiful beach, clean and lovely!

reviews.title: Lovely day when in Sydney
reviews.text: Got there on the tourist bus, which gave a great overview of the area on the trip and stopped every hour. It was super hot, did some beach time but also some better than expected shopping

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Very picturesque beach with the nice clean sand and beautiful color water. Lifeguards on duty every day plus lifesavers on weekends. Nice beach to hang out and enjoy the view and day.

reviews.title: Beach
reviews.text: The beach to be if you live here or are here for a holiday. Clean n visitors help to keep it up to it's mark. Great place to swim, to tan, to surf, to eat drink n party

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach!
reviews.text: This is a beautiful beach to sit down on the sand and watch the ocean and people walking by. The ocean breeze is very nice and warm. Also, nice to walk on the beach as well. There are public washrooms and change rooms but really high traffic area. No shade. Really enjoyed just sitting at the beach!

reviews.title: It's just a beach
reviews.text: I don't get the hype - it's just another beach. I didn't find anything unique about it other than the walk to Coogee beach (see Bondi to Coogee walk on TripAdvisor)

reviews.title: Enormous beach
reviews.text: Lovely place with an extraordinarily wide beach. Hard to park nearby, so be prepared to do public transport or take a walk.

reviews.title: Nothing spectacular
reviews.text: For 30 years, I've been wanting to be on Bondi Beach since a family member used to live in ydney and had always talked about this Beach.  I went with friends and we got there using the Hop On/Hop Off bus.  We went early December so it was not that hot yet. A bit disappointed as I expected so much more of this famous beach. We're from California so maybe ...

reviews.title: A Must see
reviews.text: Had a great visit to Bondi beach had a paddle in the sea and fish and chips in the picnic area with a cool drink great to say you’ve been.

reviews.title: Must visit
reviews.text: A must visit and see. Bondi is a place to be seen and to see. The beach has life guards and watch for rips in backpackers corner near Bondi icebergs. Bondi is super popular in summet and parking limit, is pay per park.  Has all the amenities and food outlet close by. Visit the guards on duty and may be filmed for Bondi rescue tv show if not get a photo. Beach apparel is very skimpy and leave not much for the imagination. Has excellent skate park and exercise area. Take a walk along the beach foreshore after a swim and look back and enjoy the views. Check out the graf wall Totally recommend a visit.😆

reviews.title: At last I have seen it!
reviews.text: I always wanted  to visit Bondi Beach, and at last made it but oh dear the weather was foul.    It was cold, windy and occasional rain, not what you see on tv at all.  There was hardly anyone on the beach which meant for us easy walking round, we saw the lifeguard station on Bondi rescue and took the obligatory photos.       But it was worth it and definitely a place to visit.

reviews.title: Top beach in the world
reviews.text: Beautiful people, amazing beach. Wide beach and not too crowded. Changing rooms and bathrooms available. Many restaurants and bars. Great walk to Coogee.

reviews.title: Great place to visit
reviews.text: Another iconic Sydney landmark that is well worth a visit is Bondi beach.. Clean plenty to do.. Place to eat and drink.. even a couple of markets on the day we visited.. Highly recommended for all the family..

reviews.title: Not my cup-of-tea
reviews.text: Great beach for people who like crowded chaotic beaches and are going to one more from the crowd than the sand. The place is packed on a good day. Difficult to find parking. There are so many other, quieter, more secluded beaches available for the taker on the Australian coast that I don't understand why people just flock to Bondi. I had really wanted to do the Bondi-to-Bronte walk but turned away when I saw the crowds. Tamarama beach, a mile or so down South, is smaller, more picturesque, but also gets very crowded.

reviews.title: Nice and sandy beach, crowds ok for a Monday
reviews.text: Stopped here on a Monday for taking a sunbath, cool down in the ocean and enjoy the view on the surfers. Is it crowded? Most likely on the weekends, for us on Monday it was fine. Public transport is available, parking limited. Facilities (toilets, showers)  are available, but frankly, these could be cleaner, but given these are public and free it might be acceptable. Also, lockers are available. The beach does not offer any trees or similar for a cooling shadow. Besides, the spot is nice for surfing. We enjoyed the half day and would come back.

reviews.title: Iconic, but not a great beach
reviews.text: Everyone's heard of it, and if you're in Sydney, you're bound to try it. Plenty of people, nice sand and gentle, sloping beach. No particularly beautiful sights but it's OK.

reviews.title: A “Must See” visit
reviews.text: A great seafront to visit with easy walking along the esplanade and an inviting beach to walk along or laze about on. Places to sit  and watch the world. Bars, shops and public changing/ toilet/ shower conveniences. A real buzz and something for everyone.

reviews.title: Fifty Years Later
reviews.text: My husband visited Bondi Beach 50 years ago as a young serviceman.  The beach is the same but all the high rises one block from the beach are new as well as some homes on the right side of the beach facing the ocean.  I found it to be very crowded, busy, very touristy, & expensive.  It was a walk down memory lane for him.  I’m sure there are other beaches just as nice but without the crowds in Sydney.

reviews.title: Busy but a must do place to visit
reviews.text: I arrived in Sydney for the first time 3.5 years ago and yesterday was the first time I visited Bondi Beach. I quite often enjoy watching Bondi Rescue haha so it felt a little surreal actually being there! It was very busy, which I expected, but it was still a nice chilled beach to visit and check out the amazing surfers! I went on a Sunday to make use of the cheap travel (got a train from Central Station to Bondi Junction then a bus to Bondi Beach) and the overall travel time was about 20/25 minutes.

reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text: On our way to Australia we had to spend one night  in Sydney and for sure there was no better place to stay than Bondi. Strolling on the beach , watching the surfers , sipping a glass of wine while watching the colorful crowd goes by was a treat..... and the next morning after an early breakfast, taking a walk on the boardwalk , sharing the beach with the early surfers, the private gym trainers and there clients, the joggers was a sure way to get to see how people here adapt there lifestyle to the environment.

reviews.title: Iconic - but don’t miss out on other great beaches
reviews.text: There is no doubt that Bondi is iconic and well worth a visit to soak up the atmosphere and enjoy a little people watching! However, don’t miss out on some of the quieter and less known beaches along this coastline such as Tamarama.

reviews.title: Bondi Beach - meh
reviews.text: Super crowded, no white sands here. Shops had outrageous prices, restaurants were just okay; for the best food in town, I recommend the Sydney Fish Market (Head there instead). Skip Bondi, in my opinion.

reviews.title: NIce beach but busy.....
reviews.text: We went on a beautiful day and the place was packed.  However it is a beautiful beach and worth the ride out from Sydney to visit.

reviews.title: Underwhelming
reviews.text: Heard about Bondi all my life, seen the TV program re Life guards etc. The reality is that it's quite small. The sand is lovely and yes there is good surfing but the town is a bit dated and not the beach front cafés , bars and restaurants I was expecting. Seen way better beaches, better beach resorts.  Just underwhelmed really. Don't get me wrong it's not bad , it's just not the experience I had thought it would be. Chatting to Australian friends they say it's a common reaction. Especially when it's absolutely rammed with people. Enjoy but don't expect nirvana.

reviews.title: Iconic
reviews.text: Probably the most iconic beach in Australia.  We spent a little time here and visited the sculpture by the sea exhibit that was going on.  There is plenty of sand on the beach so you will have no problems finding a spot to catch some sun.  The water gets crowded at times but its a good spot to relax and watch some surfers.

reviews.title: Iconic beach
reviews.text: We had a great time at Bondi. We really enjoyed the spectacle of the surfing, the beautiful people and the scenic views. The water was perfect for a swim.A must visit when in Sydney

reviews.title: Must see in Sydney
reviews.text: Two trains and a bus from Million's Point Station. Easy and inexpensive transit to visit this beautiful beach. Clean, lots of shopping and dining available. We had lunch at Lush on the beach. We watched the lifeguards in action and enjoyed the coastal walk. Beware the power of the surf.

reviews.title: World Class Beach
reviews.text: A must see for any beach lover including those who enjoy tanning naturally. Reminds me of the California beaches out from LA. Great surf and plenty of wonderful restaurants and shops.

reviews.title: One of the nicest beaches in Sydney
reviews.text: Bondi beach is the most iconic of all the beaches in Sydney, and rightfully so. It has a ton of different bars and restaurants along the water that you can sit at and grab a drink or food and they often have specials. It’s not usually too packed except on weekends, and is well worth a visit for the day.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach, cool water
reviews.text: Visited for only an hour. Had a chance to walk the shoreline getting our feet wet. A lot of families and sun worshippers. The beach was clean and safe. Many surfers trying to catch a wave which were not very big this afternoon. Restaurants in the area but we didn't visit any.Would love to have stayed longer.

reviews.title: Overrated
reviews.text: So many far better beaches in the Sydney area. Do the Bondi to Coogee walk and you’ll see. Also Manly.

reviews.title: Walk and a beer
reviews.text: Felt I had to go to Bondi Beach why we was there had a walk along the beach to beach is not the best beach in the world is a little bit of height there was some swimmers out far we was waiting to get eaten by sharks but we didn't see any of that which was a shameWe did manage to find a nice bar across the roads where we had some beer and what still I do people pose in their cars

reviews.title: Bondi to Coogee good walk!
reviews.text: Fantastic views, great exercise (3 1/2 miles) 2 1/2 hour walk. Absolutely beautiful. Bondi to Coogee Beach is a very enjoyable walk ( taking bus back). Having reward at the Coogee Pavilion on Rooftop Bar!

reviews.title: Bondi Beach and Walk to Bronte
reviews.text: This is the second time we’ve been to Bondi Beach and did the walk to Bronte and back, the last time was 11 years ago and this time we didn’t forget our camera.The walk is still fantastic with fab views of Bondi, Tamarama & Bronte beaches.The beaches all have parks adjacent to them with full facilities that’s required for a day at the beach.Tamarama and Bronte parks have free public electric grills which are just great, we cooked our lunch on the grill at Tamarama Park.The walk has some steep steps to negotiate.There are some wonderful eroded rocks along the walk that are great for a photo opportunity.Bondi Beach is great for people watching as there’s always something going on.We took the 333 bus to Bondi which runs from Young Street near Circular Quay, a single ticket costs $3.66 each way- you can’t use cash or contactless card on this bus.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: It is a bit of hike to get there from central Sydney. It is worth the visit but the area is overated and a bit run down. The beach is very clean but crowded during the day.

reviews.title: Spectacular
reviews.text: The most spectacular each I have ever seen. No hotels rising up over it. Absolutely beautiful. So much more amazing and less touristy than Waikiki. Pull up some sand and enjoy.

reviews.title: The Rock Pools Make It.
reviews.text: The rock swimming pools built out into the sea are incredible and must be amazing to swim in with big waves crashing.There are some lovely boutiques one road back from the main hub and the best ice cream in the world at Anita’s.

reviews.title: Beautiful but crowded
reviews.text: I made the mistake of trying to go to Bondi Beach late in the morning on a Saturday. The place was packed and unsuccessfully looked for a parking spot for over an hour. I decided to re-visit early on Monday morning. This was much better. The sunrise was gorgeous, the water was blue, and the current was strong.

reviews.title: Worth a quick trip
