reviews.text: Very nice beach.  I scored a 4 because I needed to leave better marks for several Hawaii and Caribbean beaches I’ve seen. Large, beautiful, famous (if that’s your thing), with a bit calmer side toward the north end and surfing waves on the south side of the beach.  Amenities weren’t as convenient to the beach as I’d thought and souvenirs were very thin.  But if you venture off the beach to the boardwalk type area, there are a few restaurants and facilities.  Parking is every bit as bad as other reviews say.....be aware.  Pls let me know if this is helpful.

reviews.title: Golden beach Down Under
reviews.text: Ah, the great beach for Sydneysiders, any tourists - local or foreign alike who would want to experience the best of Sydney. Though of course i'm biased for our own beautiful beaches back home, this one makes for a wonderful day out.

reviews.title: Go to Manly
reviews.text: Bondi has the brand but Manly is 10 times the beach. We only saw and walked the beach for a bit as we hopped off the Hop on bus to eat, but this beach is a huge disappointment. Not great looking beach and surprisingly few services on the beach walk. I think we must have missed something. Manly is amazing, with three beaches and miles of restaurants and shops, everything you expect in a tacky beach town!Skip Bondi and go to Manly.

reviews.title: Day at the beach
reviews.text: Thoroughly enjoyed this beautiful beach. We took the “Hop on Hop off bus” from downtown Sydney to Bondi and that just added to the day. Beach is beautiful, clean, and filled with friendly people. We rented an umbrella and 2 chairs and settled in for a nice day. We ate at 1of the 3 restaurants there and had a nice lunch. Strongly recommend!

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: We visited on a weekday so no crowds. The sand is a soft powder. Surprised at how cold the water was. Fun to watch children have their surfing lessons. Beautiful

reviews.title: Urban beach
reviews.text: A beautiful urban beach setting. The sand on this beach is just fabulous.  Like fine ground sugar/salt. There are concessions aplenty and it is easy to spend time here

reviews.title: Good On Ya!
reviews.text: LUV Bondi Beach.  Pretty much amazing surfing daily.  Waves are awesome.  Gotta watch the kiddies when the waves break,  of course.  But it's a true beauty and treasure! Very large beach with incredible views,  so there's room to catch lots of rays of you're not into catching waves.  This spot if flippin gorgeous! Great shopping and all sorts of coffee,  ice cream shops,  etc., all around.

reviews.title: Bustling beach, big waves, great walking opportunity
reviews.text: Bondi is a bustling hustling beach. The day we were there, the waves were slamming and the sea was pretty rough. Lots of yelling and scolding by the lifeguards. I mean we almost jumped out of our skin when one drove up behind us and started barking out orders to swim between the flags. Absolutely gorgeous place. The walk from Bondi to Coogee is a must do! Each cone, lookout and beach is stunning or charming. Bring walking shoes and money to stop in some of the yummy restaurants along the way.

reviews.title: Sydney's Iconic Beach - Don't Miss It!
reviews.text: A beautiful beach, uncrowded on a warm summer day. We spent the day watching the swimmers, sun bathers and those with boogie boards. It sits surrounded by beautiful, ancient rock formations like nothing you have ever seen. Highly recommended for a day trip or an hour walk. Don't miss it.

reviews.title: Bondi Beach
reviews.text: Bondi Beach is a must visit when you come to Sydney. Great place to go for a walk and have a beautiful breakfast while watching the surf. Take the coastal walk past the Icebergers.

reviews.title: beautiful beach worth visiting with private club entrance honoring fallen soldiers.
reviews.text: There is a private club at end of Beach I think the initials are RSW(something like that) that you can enter as a guest with a foreign passport. It has a beautiful beach and is a restaurant and bar overlooking the area. The club is for fallen Australian soldiers with plaques and other items honoring their service from all the wars that Australia has been involved in. The food looked good. We settled for a quick dark beer from a local brewery.

reviews.title: Surfers paradise
reviews.text: Although this is a lovely beach, close to Sydney, with sandy beaches and excellent surfing, it gets very crowded, as it is not that big, and it is very popular. The surfing is amazing, and it is a lovely place to visit, however if you want to spend time on the beach, be prepared to have very close neighbours on the sand with you.

reviews.title: Always warm and inviting
reviews.text: All welcomecat yhis grest beach.No matter where you go eveyone knows BONDI. Whether you are a babe or jyst a looker get the sand between your toes at thid beach icon

reviews.title: A Spectacular Beach
reviews.text: This is not a large beach but it is beautiful with white sand, crystal clear water that has great surf breaks and several fun restaurants fyom which to enjoy the view. Lots to look at so go and enjoy for several hours.

reviews.title: classic beauty, and lots of Aussie surfing activity
reviews.text: The quintessential Australian beach, with sand, swimming areas and perfect conditions for surfers. Sometimes the surf is too wild for swimmers, though, as it was the day we were there. We watched the activity from the veranda of the Bondi Beach club, open to everyone, with good food and a wondeful birdseye view of the beach!

reviews.title: Beautiful beach, many beachfront restaurants to dine in
reviews.text: Very nice beach.  Many people on the beach, very pleasant.  We were able to rent an umbrella to sit under as the sun was very hot, although the water was still very cold, even in December which is summer in Sydney.  We walked through the stretch of restaurants fronting the beach, and enjoyed lunch at Lamrock Cafe.  From there, we took a 30-minute scenic coastal walk across the beach side path to Bronte beach.  Beautiful views of the bay as we took an easy stroll along the stone path.

reviews.title: Feeling Peace
reviews.text: If you're thinking to kill your time, you may have a slow walk along the beach side ❤Went there during my holiday, never forget the scenario of the sun set.

reviews.title: Spectacular view
reviews.text: Beach offer spectacular view of the Pacific Ocean. Lots of restaurants available for beer and snacks. Music band plays music at night time l. Ample amount of parking available. Must visit place while visiting Sydney

reviews.title: Bondi Stay
reviews.text: Bondi Beach is what it is cracked up to be, beautiful sandy beach with massive waves to play in. The beach is well patrolled by the lifeguards and if you swim within the flags you will be safe and have a great time! If you would rather surf then there is an area designated for that, and you will not be disappointed either.I went in January which is there summer and the temperature was around 45 deg but they were having a heatwave at that time.

reviews.title: Too crowded and overrated
reviews.text: Took the big bus blue line here while in Sydney. It is a nice beach, but super crowded and you are only allowed to swim in a small area. Shops nearby are expensive and full of junk.

reviews.title: New Years Day !
reviews.text: Visited on New Years Day (for those of us from the northern Hemisphere, visiting a beach on new year's day is fun).  Biggest surprise was the VERY cold water.Relatively easy to get to via Sydney Rail/bus.Area around the beach is somewhat of a tourist trap, but that is to be expected.

reviews.title: Iconic but why?
reviews.text: I guess you have to go to here but it's not a patch on Manly beach. Traffic to get there is usual heavy city, and takes 30 mins. Whilst the beach is an average size the shelter from sun, surrounding shops aren't anything helpful, but I've done it now, no reason to return!!

reviews.title: Lives up to its name
reviews.text: We came to Sydney on holiday and of course had to visit the iconic Bondi Beach. Being from California, I love my beaches.Bondi reminded me of home, and some of my favorite beaches. It has a fun, vibrant, easiness about it. Sure it touristy around the edges but down on the beach and in the water it’s pure joy. Surfers, sun soakers, people jumping in the waves, friends hanging out, white sandy beaches, that’s what it’s all about!Lifeguards on duty in all wheel vehicles cruise the beach to keep the less avid water folks close to shore. Safety is a priority here. Bathing tops, not so much. You can also rent umbrellas, chairs, boogie boards and wetsuits for reasonable fees. Lots of shops and eateries close by. We had great fresh seafood and chips at Bondi Surf Seafood Market. Well worth the visit.

reviews.title: Lovely Beach
reviews.text: Bondi is a tourist trap but is still a must visit while in Sydney. Beautiful coastal walks start here and it’s a nice way to start the he day.

reviews.title: OMG
reviews.text: It’s amazing. Lovely beach with amazing views. Had lunch at Iceberg which I would highly recommend. Took the hop on off bus from Sydney Central Train station. Do not miss a trip here if you are in the area.

reviews.title: Visit the world famous Bondi Bech and bring your bathing suit!
reviews.text: This beach has golden sands and blue waters and safe to swim but stay between the flags. Great restaurants to suit all budgets and bring the camera. Shopping is great too and you may like to buy a new bikini or board shorts & or fabulous jewellery.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach near Sydney central
reviews.text: You can take bus no 333 from Sydney central directly to Bondi beachHave a good.restaurant in the promedane On weekend is vwry crowded

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: Lovely beach we hired loungers and an umbrella for 3 hrs at a cost of 35 usd. Free wifi on the beach.

reviews.title: A Family Holiday
reviews.text: Our extended family of 7 stayed at Bondi post cruise as the teenagers wanted to experience "the vibe". We stayed for 3 nights and thoroughly enjoyed every minute. Our unit was situated only 100 metres from the beach. Walking everywhere was a breeze. Besides to have the ultimate Bondi experience you need to get amongst the crowds and walk around. An abundance of shops, eateries and drinking holes in easy reach. The summer markets on Sat and Sun at Bondi Primary School were a great distraction, with plenty of yummy offerings. The teenagers thoroughly enjoyed the beach experience, and they left feeling happy.

reviews.title: Bondi Beach is the bomb!
reviews.text: Bondi Beach is gargantuan in size and has beautiful sand and water. It also has a variety of places to eat, have ice cream, and shop. For a day of fun in the sun, Bondi Beach is a great choice. You will also have fun watching the surfers as they go about their business in the water.

reviews.title: Tourist beach
reviews.text: The beach is pretty nice but it is very crowded. Yes, it is a tourist beach. The beach is really big and there are many of cafes, restaurants, shops, and bars along the walk. It is really easy to get to the beach from the city of Sydney.

reviews.title: Not impressed
reviews.text: I have lived in Sydney all my life and can't understand what all the hype is about Bondi Beach. Trying to get there by public transport is not easy and if you drive parking is a nightmare! There are SO many other gorgeous beaches either in the area or in the north that are easier to get to and park. Seein them out unless your young and want to be seen.......

reviews.title: Busy territorial beach
reviews.text: Massive city beach,  a lot of different places to lay your towel, the toilets are not real Close so be ready. It’s gets. Very busy on a weekend so get your spot around 10 am. Swim between the flags is my suggestion especially if your not familiar with the surf.

reviews.title: Gorgeous Views, Lovely Powder Sand
reviews.text: This is a beautiful cove-like beach with gorgeous powder-like sand. There is a grassy area where people lounged and enjoyed the scenery. Sunbathers were engaged in volleyball, sun bathing and swimming. There is a nice wide promenade for those who  prefer a non-sand visual experience.

reviews.title: A bit over rated
reviews.text: Bondi is iconic, we give it that. But the traffic is insane, there is people everywhere snd therefore not the cleanest beach ever.It is a surf beach so if you are not a proficient swimmer stay away from the water and only swim between the flags. With so many beautiful  beaches in Sydney I really think you can get a better experience elsewhere.

reviews.title: Day at Bondi
reviews.text: Beautiful beach Clean Sea is beautiful Strong undercurrent so best to swim between the flags An iconic have to see beach Very busy in summer

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: We visited Bondi beach on the big bus tour. Well worth a visit but can be rather busy especially with surfers.

reviews.title: Gorgeous day
reviews.text: Loved a day on bondi beach whilst travelling through Sydney. The beach was relaxing and entertaining with plenty local amenities in the area.

reviews.title: Surprised!
reviews.text: I must say I was very surprised when I visited Bondi Beach.  Because it has such an iconic status, I think I expected more!  It’s not very big and fortunately as we visited on a weekday, not too busy.  I wouldn’t like to go at the weekend.  Having said that I enjoyed the visit.   We also managed to find the best cafe we’ve been in since we arrived in Sydney 10 days ago - Trio.  Excellent.

reviews.title: Dinner on the beach at Bondi
reviews.text: Brilliant spot - not just cause family have lived here for many years - but it's got that small-town vibe, yet there's designer stores as well. A must is the gelato icecream store it's brilliant. They let you try various flavours and its a delectable treat. Loads of spots to have dinner including fish and chips with a cold beverage and a view of the beach... or any number of take-away stores.  So much action and swimming of course too, plus loads of surfers... so funny to see the surfers on the bus and trains with their boards (but only cause we walk to our beach round the corner in NZ) it's just their way of life. Easy to access by train and bus from the CBD or bus...

reviews.title: Enjoyed our Brief Visit
reviews.text: Our tour group stopped by to stroll the promenade and shops. The beach is quite expansive and had plenty of beach goers. A pretty area.

reviews.title: Everything I Dreamed Of
reviews.text: I’ve wanted to go to Bondi since I was a little girl and it did not disappoint. We took the bus from Circular Quay and upon arrival, it was a short walk down to the sand.The beach was busy the first time we were there but not to the point you were tripping over one another.It is imperative that you only swim in the designated areas to avoid dangers such as rips and surfers.The second day we were there, they were having some event with a bunch of tiny kids who appeared to be training to be lifeguards. It was amazing to watch these (in some cases toddlers), being put through drills.The water was much colder than I expected and very rough. You need to keep you eyes on the ocean and be aware of potentially crushing shore break.

reviews.title: Bondi
reviews.text: Try to find a grain of sand at the place to be seen Bondi Beach especially on a long weekend.  Did the tourist thing and saw some of the Bondi Rescue boys, had a swim, people watched but not sure why the hype? . Australia is truly blessed with its beautiful beaches and coastlines.  Enjoy them all not just Bondi

reviews.title: It is Sydney Iconic beach.
reviews.text: A must see for all visitors to Sydney.   There are plenty of places to eat and drink.  Finding a spot on the sand maybe a different story.  If driving you can always find a place to park you may have to walk a bit but the walk is pleasant and you are here to see Bondi and walking is the best way to see Bondi at its best. People watching at bondi is a great way to past time.... All the beaches along our wonderful coast are worth going to. It is a patrolled beach so swim between the flags you should be fine. Its not the cheapest area to buy food in but most of the places are with a sea view.(Beach View.)

reviews.title: Must See when in Sydney
reviews.text: Just a 20 dollar away With uber This nuce City and Beach us a must With many Nice restaurants and grea surfing If you Are into that, and great Big Beach

reviews.title: Fun but crowded and expensive
reviews.text: As a famous beach that draws massive flocks of tourists, you can imagine that there isn’t much space. Good luck finding enough open sand for your gaggle of friends to each pitch a lawn chair. But the beach itself is quite beautiful, and if you go on the off season, it’s actually not too bad.

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: Great beach, you can hire beach umbrellas and chairs. Shops across thed road, Woolworths sell great freshly made sushi. Happy hour at bondi hotel good valu also.

reviews.title: A Special Beach in Australia  but very ordinary
reviews.text: The Australians have a love affair with Bondi Beach. Do not blame them because this is among the best beaches they have for safe swimming, A semi circle beach between residential or commercial areas on both sides, this beach does get very crowded on a summer day but provides an opportunity to swimmers and surfers to enjoy the ocean.This beach cannot compare to many white sand beaches in Africa in places like Seychelles, Mauritius, Tanzania and Kenya where swimming can be done with no risk from predators.Munir D.

reviews.title: Clean pretty beach
reviews.text: We actually liked the vibe of manly beach a lot better. The day we went unfortunately the weather wasnt great, cloudy, cold and extremely windy so it wasnt crowded at all. We did a very long walk and walked down to Bronte beach along the coast. Not a bad walk but it was so windy when we went was blowing me over. Walk took about 45 min to an hour one way. The beach itself is very clean. There is a place with a changing room and restrooms. Lots of shops and restaurants. There are lifeguards and a station if you get injured.  There is a place to rent chairs, surfboards etc but they RIP you off if you go at the end of the day. It is $10 per chair for 3 hours so we rented 2 chairs and then they said oh we are closing early at 4 so you only have an hour 1/2 but they charged us full price! Wasnt happy about that.  The bus ride from circular quay takes a very long time due to all the stops. We went back to manly for a 2nd visit instead of coming back here.

reviews.title: Not as good as you think it'll be...
reviews.text: Bondi Beach is iconic and billed as a must see attraction when visiting Sydney but sadly for me it didn't live up to the hype. Yes there's golden sands, amazing surf and beautiful weather but there is also massive overcrowding (to the point you can't find a space to sit on the beach), litter and loads of obnoxious gap year backpackers. I'm glad to have ticked it off my bucket list but would recommend Manly for a much better beach experience.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Enjoyed walking aling the boardwalk and the clean sand. Many stores on Bondi Road for drinks food and miscellaneous. Lots of drinking water taps and bins to put garbage. All in all very enjoyable and free!

reviews.title: Must
reviews.text: Most famous beach in Sydney. Huge and crowded but definitely worth visiting. It's nice even to take a walk or have a drink in nearby caffes.

reviews.title: Christmas visit to Bondi
reviews.text: After spending most of the day in Watsons Bay, my wife & myself called into Bondi on the way home. The weather was perfect, everyone seemed chilled and there was a great vibe. We enjoyed an ice cream on Campbell Parade whilst checking out all the shops. An enjoyable few hours.

reviews.title: What’s not to love
reviews.text: Recently enjoyed a few days at Bondi Beach.Great safe beach, thanks to all the lovely lifeguards.Lovely area to walk, swim & have a meal.My son got to meet quite a few of the lifeguards ( Bondi Rescue fan) which he loved.

reviews.title: BEST BEACH EVER
reviews.text: Bondi Beach is a must when visiting NSW the people are so friendly restaurants are amazing and something for everyone taste and budget water was surprisingly very cold  was very surprised that everything closed at 9pm even on NEW YEARS EVE

reviews.title: Just what we expected.
reviews.text: Spent three nights in an Airbnb. Walked everywhere. Beach was great. Felt very safe. Would be great if the locals put some time into their neighbourhood (cleaning up bins, rubbish on side of roads,mowed nature strips).

reviews.title: Very nice and fashion beach
reviews.text: Incredible views!!!! You can take hundreds of photos!!! Too many people almost every day in summer. Difficult to find a place in the sand A lot of surfers ... Take the Coastal Walk: it is amazing!!!!!!

reviews.title: Iconic location
reviews.text: Iconic beach, cool scenery. Sea was had a fair amount of weed in places. Lots of shops and bus stops nearby so easy to get to. Worth a visit if you’re a tourist but lots of other beaches that are nicer near by such as Manly.

reviews.title: Bondi busy...
reviews.text: Probably not the best day to go, New Year's Day... it was busy but also beautiful and the weather was hot, hot, hot. Make sure you wear something sensible on your feet and take a hat. You can rent umbrellas and sunloungers as well as lockers but the later it is the higher the likelihood they will be sold out. The water was cool, but good fun, and there are always a good mix of people. Worth a visit.

reviews.title: A great beach with a wide range interesting people
reviews.text: Having always wanted to visit it was surreal to finally be on the famous Bondi Beach. It is a nice place with a great vibe and a wide mix of characters on show. The lifeguards are all very friendly and have a tough job on a busy day. i'd highly recommend a visit.

reviews.title: Beach town
reviews.text: I lived in bondi for 15 year and have some great friends with fond memories. I moved on when the place became to expensive to live with attitude

reviews.title: Overcrowded . . . and not that clean
reviews.text: The famous Bondi Beach - used to be the hang-out for sun-lovers, surfers and families to have their picnic.Now it is simply an overcrowded piece of sand with the smell of sewerage gently wafting up from the waves

reviews.title: True representation of Australia
reviews.text: It was a bit day when I reached there, and it felt that Sydny-niers are really facing heat....Man n women of all color were there and really enjoying.

reviews.title: The epicentre of Sydney
reviews.text: Not the best beach for surfing, but definetely a top spot for everything else. Even the 333 work really good. The vibe is so unique that I'll be difficult to find a similar place in the world.

reviews.title: Really nice beach near Sydney
reviews.text: this beach is really nice and full of life. It's definitely worth visiting and spending some time there. some great restaurants and cafes nearby where you can experience local stuff

reviews.title: Evening stroll
reviews.text: We decided to do the mandatory visit down to Bondi late in the arvo to avoid most of the heat and crowds, which paid off. Nice peaceful afternoon just watching to world go buy on the steps and from one of the restaurants as sun set. Will be back for a swim one day.

reviews.title: Nice enough beach but nothing out of the ordinary
reviews.text: Don’t go here with any high expectations of anything particularly special - at end of day it’s just a very busy beach. That said it’s a nice beach and very popular. Water was warm and lots of people were swimming and surfing. Also lots of life guards on the beach so you feel safe when in the water.The town of Bondi offers lots of shops and restaurants/cafes!

reviews.title: Great spot to visit. Recommendations below!
reviews.text: I went in mid January which is the tourist time of the year. Watch out for the weather since that will make or break your experience. The beach has male and female changing rooms, showers, and restrooms as well as stores to purchase Bondi merchandise as well as food.The beach does have topless tanning, so that’s just something to be aware of. Most of the ladies that do are appropriate about it and often do it far from the water.To get the the beach using public transportation, recommend using an Opal card and putting at a minimum of $10 AUD. Take the rail on T4 to Bondi Junction Station. From there, take the bus to Bondi Beach.

reviews.title: The beach to go to
reviews.text: A trip to Sydney would not be complete without a trip to this beach.   Some touristy stops and great people watching.

reviews.title: Best place in Bondi with the coolest and friendliest owner.
reviews.text: Been to Tony’s on all occasions we have visited Bondi-Beach. Our latest visit was made very special by all of the staff and by Tony himself, he went out of his way to make it a wonderful fun evening especially for my grandchildren of 6 and 4. Everything Tony and his staff do is for the customer and it’s one of our favourite places in Australia let alone Bondi.Thanks Tony

reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text: A must see if you visit Sydney. Such a beautiful beach. It is a Great place to have a swim under the watchful eyes of yhe famous Bondi Rescue people. There are so many options for  food at Bondi, it is hard to make a choice, but all were very busy. A good sign of quality. There are a few nice places to walk with great views and some great spots to sit under a tree and take ot all in. Make it if you can

reviews.title: Iconic Sydney beach
reviews.text: Outstanding beach in Sydney, easily reachable by train to Bondi junction + bus connection. Beautiful public art displays of murals on the walls. Very clean beach and great eco-awareness. Swimming in lifeguarded areas only. Lots of restaurants/cafes--recommend "The Bucket List" for a lunch stop (burgers, fish tacos). Highly recommend the Bondi-Coogee coastal walk--it's breathtaking.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Came on a 30 degree summer day. Very impressed. Beautiful views, soft sand, lovely waves, nice place for the boys to catch some waves on their bodyboards. We rented an umbrella and 2 deck chairs. Lunch was at Campbell Parade. Everyone left feeling happy.

reviews.title: If you visit Sydney without exploring Bondi Beach, sorry, but you're a loser!
reviews.text: Even if you're only in Sydney for a few days, you really must check-out Bondi Beach. You will see why it's one of the World's most famous beaches.

reviews.title: Perfect beach, very clean
reviews.text: Somebody else said that I walked onto the beach and forgot I was in Australia. This is a great beach very busy yet plenty of room, well protected with life guards and good facilities around. Loads of room to play ball games, run around have fun, we hired an umbrella and lounges which were pretty well priced and boards for the kids, the waves rolled in , then the wind dropped, it was perfect, everyone had a great day. Thanks Bondi , we will return

reviews.title: Great escape
reviews.text: After going for 3 days no stop at Sydney we took a couple of days to enjoy our vacation and run to the beach is only 30 minutes away from downtown Sydney the blue line of double decker stop but if you ready want to enjoy the beach stay at least a couple of days is beautiful taxi cost less than $40 Australian dollars from Sydney Beach is beautiful but the water is super cold even in December

reviews.title: Bondi bliss
reviews.text: First time visiting, and I forgot that I was still in Australia!  It was s amazing, right down to the magnificent water and beach, to the inviting green grass sitting area. The ambiance is perfect summer tunes. Parking is the only down fall, but still won’t stop me from visiting again.

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: Wonderfull campus beach.High waves. Close to the strip and nice atmosphere. Busy with a lot of people but very nice

reviews.title: Day out
reviews.text: Fun day at the beach, so easy to access with the bus. Getting to a surf beach in 3O min with an express bus is just so convenient. Can hire umbrellas and chairs, heaps of shops around, therefore no need to pre pack food.

reviews.title: Evening at beach
reviews.text: Near perfect conditions be at beach.No waves for the surfer's.Had desert across the road. Great day

reviews.title: Not My Favourite Beach
reviews.text: Now, to be up front, I am not a fan of sand. I don't like it. I'm on Anakin Skywalker's side when it comes to sand. It's rough and it's coarse and it gets everywhere.Having said, the sand on Bondi beach is the most amazingly fine sand I've seen, I had to walk around in it and paddle in the water a bit.I don't think Bondi seems like a very safe beach, in terms of the pull of the tide. The fine sand just seems to go out to see with every wave, meaning the beach takes a massive slope once you get to the water and the water can become deep very fast. That's probably great for surfing, but I think with little ones, and we had a child with us, you would need to be careful and very watchful.

reviews.title: Don’t bag the people who put there own lives on the line to save others every day they work
reviews.text: I got caught in a rip at Bondi while trying to teach myself how to surf (bad idea!). Fortunately I’m a strong swimmer so managed to get back to the beach eventually.  I had absolutely no strength left in my body and I was 150 metres down from the point where I entered the water. During this ordeal I was watched by a a lifesaver who instantly recognised I might be in trouble and I new that if I lifted my hand he would save me...awesome!   Now as a father of four kids and nurse I would like to point out that it’s not the he job of these guys to look after our children,.  It’s the job of we parents. If they get stung by jelly fish it’s our fault for taking them in.  Go to the beach with stingoes and don’t blame these outstanding human beings for your own mistake!   Legends every one.   Andy the Scotsman.

reviews.title: Great beach town
reviews.text: It was a hot vacation week in Sydney so the beach was very crowded.  Fun to shop and watch the scene. Other nearby beaches were quieter.  There are places to rent beach gear and surf boards.

reviews.title: Beautiful tourist beach full of people
reviews.text: This is a big area that you can do a lot of beach activities.  Full of people when we visit in December.  It seems a safe place to stroll and watch people. It worths a visit but the place is kind of overrated.

reviews.title: Great day trip.
reviews.text: Came here from the UK to see the lifeguards from the famous tv programme. Unfortunately no one was around, didn’t like to knock on the door, the beach is beautiful and the buildings around it are very nice. Lush white sand.

reviews.title: Best beach in Syd
reviews.text: I can say that Bondi is the best beach in Sydney. Good wave to surf, and there is parking very near to the beach.

reviews.title: Day Out
reviews.text: The beach was not as big as I imagined but none the less still a great place to sit and watch the surfers and being such an iconic place to visit it's a must do in Sydney

reviews.title: Famous Beach
reviews.text: We were staying in Sydney and got a Light Rail to the Bondi Junction and caught a bus to the Beach. It was a chilly slightly windy day for the time of year so few people were actually on the beach. It was quite impressive as beaches go but coming from South Africa its difficult to impress when held up to Cape Town and its beaches.

reviews.title: Famous beach worth a visit
reviews.text: Rather crowded but wort a visit anyway, and a great start for the southbond coastal walk. Fun to watch all the surfers

reviews.title: My Favorite
reviews.text: between Bondi and Coogee, this is my favorite beach. Both have unique offerings, but I loved the artwork along the walls and being able to get away from the crowd to explore further away. Beach was also crowded during my visit, but there are ways to still have fun. Lots to do and would visit again.

reviews.title: Just OK
reviews.text: Well!What is the big deal? Police do not support the life guards. Jelly fish abound. Thousands of people. Surf and more surf, exactly what you will find all up and down the Australian coast. This is nothing but a money grab. A place to avoid.

reviews.title: Best beach!
reviews.text: By far the best beach in Sydney! Was really awesome to be there on new year's day and finish a great vacation in Sydney

reviews.title: Nice but touristy!
reviews.text: The beach is pretty nice but it is very crowded. Definitely a tourist beach. But the beach is really big and there are tons of restaurants, shops, and bars along the walk. It is really easy to get to this beach from the center of Sydney, which is really nice!

reviews.title: calm waves, clean and busy beach
reviews.text: it was christmas day and everything was shut. there was nothing other than bondi beach to go to. it was so busy as everyone had the same idea we missed 3 full buses before we could get there. but the ride was worth it. we stopped at the far end of the beach and not the middle where there were shops and restaurants as i felt that place was more full. the far end was little less populated but it had no food. sobif u want food please get off in the middle area. the day was well spent the beach is super safe with calm waves and u can go pretty far from shore and still feel pretty safe no strong undercurrents. we had a great time.

reviews.title: What's the hype about this beach?
reviews.text: Probably the most boring beach as there hardly any shading during the heatwave time. Park area is tiny and dirty. Garbage bins were full and most garbage thrown all around. This beach is nothing compared to Manly. Restaurant choices are limited too

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: We visited as part of a tour and got to walk around and have lunch while watching the surfers. Several of our group plan to go back tomorrow to actually surf.

reviews.title: Iconic and beautiful!
reviews.text: Depending on the time of year, this beach will have a different impact on visitors. We were blessed with beautiful weather which allowed us to drive with the windows down all the way to the beach and enjoy an afternoon on the beach. It can get a bit crowded on hotter days but nonetheless the beach is huge and be advised to follow the instructions by the lifeguards and make your trip a safe one and their job easier. If you drive to Bondi like we did (we're not from Sydney) the roads can be very steep and narrow like the rest of Sydney. Better to take public transport :).

reviews.title: Swimming at Bondi
reviews.text: Bondi beach is a must see when visiting Sydney.  We visited on 29 Dec 2018.   The beach clean but crowded as can be expected.  What was not expected was how dirty the bathrooms were.  Coming from Africa I though I was use to dirty bathrooms, but this was on another level.  The ladies bathrooms was very unhygienic, with used sanitary ware lying on the floor.  If you do visit Bondi beach brace yourself for the bathrooms.

reviews.title: Go Early
reviews.text: Being really the nearest beach around Sydney apart from Manley it gets busy purchase your opal card and use it on the blue line from st James or kings cross 2 stops from kings cross then head to the bus all within the same complex no 338 or 333 will take you directly to the beach. Remember to tap in and out with your opal cards. You’ll get the hang of it quite a cool system they have.I’d say get there for around 9am you’ll be ready to leave by 12 as it becomes extremely busy if your a die hard and don’t mind the crowds you’ll be fine

reviews.title: A social beach
reviews.text: Me and my family visited the beach and it was a good day out. There is plenty to do with water activities, such as swimming and surfing. Lots if places to eat but also free use if the BBQs to cook your own food. There is plenty of grass for those that don’t like the sand. The beach is very busy so a very social location.Overall a fun day out. Not tranquil so don’t go if you want peace and quiet.

reviews.title: cool seas
reviews.text: Went there with my family and friends. The beach was clean in fact one of the cleanest seen. The parking was ample and very near to the beach. Though it was quite windy at that time and the winds were chilling the view was fabulous with people exercising and jogging on the beach. The overall experience was very good.

reviews.title: ❤️ Bondi Beach
reviews.text: We love Bondi Beach. So much happening and heaps of food options to choose from. Don’t come to Oz without visiting Bondi 🙂

reviews.title: Its why you visit Sydney
reviews.text: When you come to Australia the first thing you want to do is go to Bondi Beach. It's one of the most iconic beaches in the world and once you get there you know why. It has an amazing atmosphere and the Lifesavers are always on the lookout. Don't get me wrong there are other beaches that are better but Bondi Beach is where it's at. You can spend the entire day there relaxing, swimming and eating at the lovely cafes. The biggest problem is parking! If you can find a good parking spot you will be paying up to $20 for the entire day. Public transport is not bad you can catch the bus from Bondi Junction. The only thing I will warn everyone about is the surf is dangerous for people that aren't used to swimming in Australian waters. So don't be a bloody idiot and swim between the flags. There is no smoking or drinking alcohol on the beach sorry you Europeans I know this upsets you. Make sure you pack plenty of sunscreen, water and sunglasses. If you're feeling energetic you can always do the coastal walk but make sure you take your stuff because it could get stolen.

reviews.title: Nice Beach
reviews.text: A place to go and relax. Nice beach surrounded by restarurantes and bars. Ideal fo those who like surf. You can visit the beachfront promenade, enjoy a coffee or cool drink and the best panoramic view at Dover Heights.

reviews.title: Great fun for everyone, in the water and on the beach
reviews.text: Grab a lounger and an umbrella (easy to rent) and enjoy the best people watching west of Waikiki. The whole world comes to Bondi and the life guard club and the local police dona terrific job of keeping it safe.  The surf and tides are not for the novice swimmer so be warned.....know your limitations and stay between the flags. It seems the guards were pulling people out of the surf all day long.

reviews.title: Like any other beach
reviews.text: I used to come here a lot but find myself not coming here as often as I used too. While the beach is lovely and beautiful, I don’t see why the big hype and fuss is over it. There are plenty of other beaches close to Bondi which are just as nice and less crowded. There are too many tourists that come here and leave their rubbish behind. On a weekend and on a hot day, this beach is full of people and you really have to try and find a spot to set up. There is very minimal shade at Bondi, so make sure you pack an umbrella or tent with you if it is a hot day. The waves can be pretty big and the current can be strong, so please make sure you swim between the flags. The good thing about Bondi is that across the road, you have a variety of food options to choose from. I would not recommend you drive to Bondi Beach as the parking is very limited and is terrible. I would suggest you catch the train to Bondi Junction and then catch the bus to Bondi Beach. There are frequent trains and buses that run to Bondi Beach.

reviews.title: Looks like a nice beach
reviews.text: I was in town for one day and went to Bondi Beach. The beach looks fantastic.  Unfortunately, the weather did not cooperate. It was cool and dreary - much too cool to consider swimming or lying on the beach. We walked on the beach with a few other die hards, then walked across the street to one of the bars for draft beers.

reviews.title: Sardine style
reviews.text: Too crowded with people everywhere. Hardly any parking and also very expensive parking. The worst beach EVER!

reviews.title: Lots of people and high waves
reviews.text: The beach is nice, the sand is very nice and contrary to popular belief (mine and my fam’s) you could actually walk on it barefoot! Even though there were a lot of people (probably not as much as there could be) it was easy to find a spot for the entire family close to the water! The waves are pretty high, but if you’re not that good of a swimmer or if you have kids, stay close to the shore as there are some pretty scary currents!

reviews.title: Nice
reviews.text: It was a windy day when we got there, but it was worth it. We took the bus to Bondi Junction with Opal card (must have when you travel with public transportations). From Bondi beach you can take a long walk to other beaches with nice view. Absolutely worth a trip with kids or for couples. After a nice walk can you have a nice meal in Bondi Junction square. There were a lot of food you can choose from and with a lot goodie stands.

reviews.title: Almost brilliant bondi
reviews.text: My first time to bondi and pleasantly surprised. The quality of the sand and sea are actually quite good. Gets crowded but people watching is part of the fun. Lots of shops around to get your sunblock, snacks and water

reviews.title: Great day out
reviews.text: I visited here on a Sunday morning, what a great beach. It's very well patrolled. It's buzzing with people but plenty of space. One of the most busiest beaches I've seen. Can certainly spend a few days here. Plenty of bars on the harbour to grab food or a drink. A must if you're in Sydney.

reviews.title: Love Bondi
reviews.text: So Australian Bondi is such a vibrant, lively place full of people walking & exercising. What a great place to be

reviews.title: Fun and lively even during winter
reviews.text: Likes: Just the right amount of quietness and liveliness. There was an event when I came here but even so, a walk by the beach was relaxing. Maybe because it's winter that is why the breeze was refreshing. I also liked the wall arts/murals. Made me wanna take a picture on each art. Watched the sunset here and it's lovely.Dislikes: Because there were a lot of people, it was hard to find a place where I can just sit and relax. But that's not much of a big deal actually

reviews.title: Loved it
reviews.text: The best beach in the area. Lots of history. The graffiti along the wall and the wall art is very impressive. Tons of places to eat nearby.

reviews.title: Busy
reviews.text: It’s an iconic beach which is buckling under the weight of its overwhelming popularity. The public transport is trying but is hampered by those taking cars. Private cars should be banned.

reviews.title: Amazing beach and surf
reviews.text: We went for an afternoon to Bondi Beach to take our teenage son surfing and we had a great time. Facilities throughout were good. Surf board hire for $25 at Ripcurl shop opposite was excellent and they were so friendly.  Plenty of places to shop for souvenirs and sit for a coffee.  Best way to get there is T4 from city to Bondi Jnct and then bus to beach which is very regular and easy to find

reviews.title: Christmas day out
reviews.text: Crazy waves! Excellent life guards, good access to facilities. Soft sand, plenty of space, keep little ones close and listen to the lifeguards for your safety.

reviews.title: Vast beach
reviews.text: We had seen this place of the tv quite a few times in bindi rescue so were keen to see it in real life. Didn’t disappoint, just a shame the weather didn’t help us out. Still a lovely beach though.

reviews.title: Cold summer at Bondi
reviews.text: It’s summer time but still rather cold in December. Strong wind with plenty of surfers and swimmers. There were more tourists than local.

reviews.title: Best beach in Sydney
reviews.text: Love this beach! Absolutely beautiful and definitely worthwhile to go. Lots of great shopping and excellent food nearby

reviews.title: Global meeting spot
reviews.text: One of the most famous beaches in the world. There is everything and more. Just walking down the beach you will hear accents from all over the world. Cafes and bars with magnificent views. There are surely beaches in nicer surroundings, but this is one of a kind when it comes to meeting up with other nationalities. Prices are pretty steep, parking and drinks/food included so if you’re on a budget bring your own and arrive by public transport.

reviews.title: Has to be done !!
reviews.text: Nice Beach - there are many better, but it’s iconic and has to be done.  Parking is very expensive though

reviews.title: Had to go
reviews.text: There are a weird daytime fog which made for some interesting photos and the girls enjoyed running from the surf and the experience in general (now addicted to Bondi Rescue). Getting there was a hit of a pain, as buses ain't that clearly labeled as everyone asked at every bus stop if we were going to Bondi Beach.

reviews.title: Sydney Landmark
reviews.text: An iconic beach worth a visit just to say that you have been there. The pavilion offers a number of classes in diverse subjects (pottery, meditation, etc). Good gelato at the beach side restaurant.

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: We went to Bondi Beach on a Saturday and it was packed with people. A lot of twenty-somethings having a good time. Just walking along the boardwalk is great. No shortage of places to eats as well.

reviews.title: Musst see
reviews.text: Bondi is probably the most known beach in Sydney. It's good for swimming, getting tanned and for surfing. Also the Icebergs are next to it, if you are interested in new photos on social media 😉

reviews.title: Fun beach!
reviews.text: Bondi Beach is an iconic spot to visit. The beach is soft and clean, the waves are good for a surf, and because it’s 1 km long there’s a lot of space. The views are stunning, especially from the north end of the beach by Ben Buckler. The pavilion is right there for restrooms, food, and trinkets. For a tourist beach, it is very nice for a visit with easy access to the main shops, buses, and food.

reviews.title: Wow wow wow!!
reviews.text: The travel book said that we would not be impressed!  Boy, were they wrong.  We used public transit to travel from centre town Sydney and the bus dropped us right in front of the beach.  What a sight to behold!  This is a huge beach with acres and acres of white sand and turquoise blue water.  On a Sunday, the beach was peppered with locals and tourists alike trying to catch some rays and swim the dangerous waves.  We did stick our feet in the water and found it extremely cold!!!  The beach has a few nice eateries and we did have lunch there and found the food at par as far as prices goes with venues elsewhere and the food was quite good.  There are change rooms and toilets and stalls with lots of tourism information.The beach is well managed with lifeguards and surfing guards on site.  Be sure to do the Bondi to Coogee walk - it's so well worth the hike!

reviews.title: A great place to sit and people watch
reviews.text: Bondi Beach is really beautiful and while crowded, everyone there is friendly and there to do the same thing as you, swim, sunbake or relax. If interested, walk to the right side and around the cliffs. The view is simply stunning.

reviews.title: Very good
reviews.text: I had been told of mixed views on this beach before I got there so was not sure what to expect.I was surprised and in a good way.We were ther at a weekend so it was busy. That said, it was well set up with very good facilities.

reviews.title: very large and still crowded
reviews.text: The size of this beach is large compared with the neighbouring beaches. Public transport to Sidney is frequent, but at the end of the day you can best walk to the north side because at the south side you may not be able to get a place in the bus.

reviews.title: Beautiful Clear Water
reviews.text: Bondi is very busy, lots of people watching & that is part of its charm. It has incredible surf and clear water.

reviews.title: Beautiful views but amazing surf!
reviews.text: Its the most famous beach in Sydney and probably in Australia. Its really beautiful and lots of green space if all the sandy area is taken with families, backpackers and students. If you're not a good swimmer its better to go to another beach as here the surf could be very dangerous as the waves are usually very big!Plenty of restaurants and cafes as well as a very scenic coast walk!

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: After so, the hype associated with this world known beach we were disappointed. It's a nice beach and good for surfing but the area is tacky and overrated. It was packed on day we went but it is quite a nice beach itself but surroundings let it down. My advice is take ferry to Manly beach instead where you can surf too but in much nicer surroundings and area.

reviews.title: Excellent view with clear water
reviews.text: Hi Visited this place for Adidas Parley Event to promote the banning of plastic material being used and thrown into the oceans. we had 4km walk around the beach for this event. It was in the evening time and was amazed to see so many people having fun surfing, doing water rides ,etc.

reviews.title: Everything and more
reviews.text: Went there to have a quick swim and body board.  I was amazed at how big it really is.  Found the hire places on the beach very easily to hire my body board.  Water is crystal clear and had a lot of fun in the surf.

reviews.title: AMAZING
reviews.text: Bondi Beach was a very last minute decision to go to for me. It’s quite far away from the city but the Uber ride was totally worth it. The beach was the prettiest beach I’ve ever seen. The sand was so soft. The water was crystal clear. Although a bit chilly it didn’t stop others from going out and surfing. I was there at sunset and the view was amazing. I highly recommend this beach as a must see spot while you’re in Sydney.

reviews.title: Walk & Talk
reviews.text: If you want a full day with your spouse then we highly recommend Bondi. My new wife and I started our day at the rock swimming pool and ended at the opposite end on top of the cliffs. We spent the whole day walking and talking ..Great Day Out

reviews.title: Awesome Beach
reviews.text: Bondi beach is one of the most famous beaches, not only in Sydney, but also in entire Australia. It is close to Sydney CBD, can go by bus or train. From Bondi junction bus station, buses are available to Bondi beach. Food shop are available there. Getting a parking is hard.

reviews.title: Bathing and surfing
reviews.text: The sun tanning people have the luxury to choose to be on either nice sand or perfectly cut grass. There are outdoor gyms and also a small pool area with sea water for the young. So this beach is great for both families and others.The water is clear and I like the colour and the beach is pretty clean and the sand is nice.On the other side of the road you have the possibility to shop more or less whatever and eat and drink.This is of course one of the most popular beaches and the most well known beach outside Australia. So it can be pretty crowded. If you are ok with the crowd this is the beach for you!

reviews.title: Nice view but WA beaches are better
reviews.text: Whilst in Sydney it's a must do  it is a great beach very popular not as big as I thought it would be . I feel West Aust had nicer beaches though

reviews.title: Average city beach
reviews.text: We decided to stay at the beach after the coastal walk. The other beaches along the coastal walk were nicer. This beach is big and has notoriety, but not sure why. I much enjoy going to Venice Beach in Los Angeles more. Not sure what the draw is for this beach, other than it’s a big beach that’s closest to Sydney.

reviews.title: Bondi beach
reviews.text: Spent the day at Bondi beach lovely clean beach, easy to travel to via train and bus from Sydney. Plenty of eateries close by

reviews.title: Best Beach in the City
reviews.text: Bondi is undoubtedly the best beach in sydney. As soon as one arrives on the beach the sound of water and waves taken onto ears and when one thinks that it's so good the eye rests on the graffiti art done on the wall and every single art is so pleasing to watch. At the end one could not stop himself from approaching the water and getting feet wet. Seagulls are also good to see there and apartments on the cliffs look so satisfying with people who can be seen over the cliffs. Over all a good place to be with friends and family.

reviews.title: Overcrowded and underrated
reviews.text: This beach is all the hype and show but it’s like having a bath with your entire family and a dozen strangers. It’s packed on any normal day and should be regulated with a fence line and tickets so it’s not like cramming sardines into a can. My advice, don’t bother wasting your time. You can’t sit anywhere, swim without your body rubbing against a stranger or eat across the road without queuing. The city of Bondi has failed its community in a quest of greed here.

reviews.title: Sydney Business & Pleasure trip
reviews.text: Loved this beach!! I’ve traveled to Cuba, Jamaica & Mexico and this beach is comparable ❤️ don’t miss visiting this beach if your in Sydney!!

reviews.title: "noise of water breaking over rocks"
reviews.text: Closing my eyes, listen to the nature. Listing to the Rollin waves as they try to survive on the steady rocks. Look at the waves, try to flush away the most beautiful sand of my beach. The most beautiful beach on earth

reviews.title: Sprawling Sandy Beach - Surfer's Galore!
reviews.text: Bondi Beach is a mecca for surfers and is close to Paradise!  The variety of sports is endless here: surfing, paddle boarding, kayaking, swimming, volleyball, snorkelling, scuba, you name it.  Lots of young people and families have a blast!  The beach is surrounded with shopping, restaurants and bars to complete the day.  The trails along the coastline will give you a birds-eve view of dolphins and migrating whales too.  Also a good place for birding. Always a favourite for locals, tourists and residents of Sydney who wish to enjoy a first-rate beach experience.

reviews.title: A must visit if going to Sydney
reviews.text: Caught a bus from the city and spent the day on Bondi beach. Great day out. Including shops and restaurants/cafes, there was everything for everyone.

reviews.title: Iconic  beach
reviews.text: It is the iconic beach associated with Sydney. Despite the high expectations, it is a very enjoyable spot.Amazing view, friendly atmosphere. Many spots to swim, tan, eat and drink!Hard to miss

reviews.title: Got to do it just to say you've been there!
reviews.text: Took the bus from central Sydney. I suggest  you buy a bus card (a bit like oyster card) from a local shop for $10 and used it for there and back, a couple of $ left on the card. It is a good way of seeing all the different neighbourhoods too.Bondi is large and busy and pretty. It has very good changing rooms, showers etc free for the public. There are some boutiques if you want to spend money and lots of cafes and restaurants. We didn't swim but lots of people were in the water.

reviews.title: Sydney 18
reviews.text: Just a few miles drive from Sydney central. Had to go and see the world famous Bondi Beach. It’s a great tourist attraction and the locals use it for fitness and obviously surfing. Great clean beach with lovely views. It was a bit cloudy on my visit but with high temperatures I would definitely visit again.

reviews.title: Beginning of Spring and already Crowded
reviews.text: We took a city tour that included Bondi beach. Though it is late spring in early December the beach was already crowded. There were nice shops along the beachfront and clean change/bathrooms.

reviews.title: Typical Beach Town
reviews.text: A nice beach town, shops and restaurants and a very nice beach for swimming & surfingNothing unique unless they have a special event going on ....

reviews.title: Nice beach + nearby food and drink
reviews.text: An easy beach to relax and enjoy the sun & surf. A few restaurants are within very easy walking distance and more are a few blocks away. It's clean and there's lots of room (at least on a weekday!)

reviews.title: Beautiful beach but there are others in close proximity that are just as nice but not as famous.
reviews.text: Beautiful large cove with soft white sands. Big waves so popular with surfers. Plenty of facilities. Does get super busy in summer- up to 35000 people! There are other smaller but equally nice beaches further along the coast that get a bit less busy. Some you can walk to and others require a short drive.

reviews.title: Holiday
reviews.text: Loved it! Beautiful sand and rolling waves! You can watch the 🏄🏼‍♀️ surfers or just chill and people watch! Lovely walks too along the waterfront, bars and cafes. Buses are regular and you can get the train from Sydney, very straight forward.

reviews.title: Lives up to its reputation!
reviews.text: What a fantastic beach, white soft sand and very clean environment, safe for families (and everyone else!), lots of shops and restaurants nearby. Lifeguards on duty and you must swim between the flags, but lots of surfing going on riding the waves as it was quite windy whilst we were there

reviews.title: Lovely sand beach
reviews.text: Got there on the hop on hop off bus.Lovely sand beach. Stood in water.Lots of shops and cafes too.Must do on any tour

reviews.title: Cold breeze in November
reviews.text: We went there late October and you can feel the cold breeze coming from the ocean.  If youre from tropical country, visiting Bondi beach this time of the year is so cold especially in the afternoon. Though during mid day the sun will literally burn your skin.  But despite all these, the beauty of Bondi beach still stands out.  Great place to hang out and just chill.

reviews.title: Poor weather spoils view
reviews.text: Picked a bad day as it was overcast- lovely sandy beach and a good number of swimmers mainly outside Australia.Great murals - pick a warm clear day

reviews.title: A must see place
reviews.text: We were holidaying in Sydney and thought we must see Bondi Beach. It was as beautiful s we imagined. Huge surf waves, fine sand that you just have to walk on. Beautifully clean.

reviews.title: Awesome Beach
reviews.text: Love this beautiful beach in Australia!!it my first time there and simply love the sand, big waves and the sun.Parking can be a little tricky when it comes to weekend a peak season.But if you are a beach goer, this is one beach you just gotta visit.Love the beach but don't wanna get dark? apart from putting on those sun block, there are small umbrella renting station around the beach.just about 15 dollars you can rent the beach umbrella for as long as you stay in the beach (not overnight though).Shower and toilet facilities also locate conveniently along the road near the beach.foods and some fashion stores can be found easily too if you want to get some souvenir such at t-shirt.As the it facing the pacific ocean thus the big strong waves, young children need to be strictly watch by the parents or guardian.

reviews.title: Nice beach, lots people and parking tight and $
reviews.text: Spoiler I am from Western Australia so hard to impress with a beach. This was just ok, homeless people about, surfer dudes, lots of tourists from overseas. The beach was busy but not packed, surf was up and looked good. Sand very yellow and nothing that cool about it - underwhelmed.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: We have traveled a lot and this is one of the most beautiful beaches very have ever seen.  It is a fun place to hang out if the weather bus good.  Definitely worth a stop if just to take pictures.

reviews.title: What has Blackpool and Bondi got in common?
reviews.text: Well its not the weather !!! But it is that they have a main busy road separating and a big beach . They also have a bit of a tacky strip and that is how I found Bondi . Its also not on the ferry or rail network so was not a great journey to get there . I did not find great cafes and food so sadly it did not live up to the hype .

reviews.title: Meh
reviews.text: I was disappointed by Bondi Beach.  I found it rather ordinary and frankly a bit tacky.  Sydney is such a fabulous city, so I was surprised that Bondi Beach didn't live up to the hype.  If you have limited time, I suggest Manly Beach as a better alternative.

reviews.title: Wonderfuk
reviews.text: The beach is beautiful with fine white sand. Between the beach and road there is a field of green which is great for picnics. Take bus 333 from Bondi Junction train station. There are shops along the main road with good food and beach stuff. Not suitable for swimming and beware if you are with children. If you are having a meal don’t feed the birds or they will swarm you.

reviews.title: Ok
reviews.text: We went as to see what all the hipe was about,but when we got there.it wasn't as big as I thought it looked good surf and good for swimming as well life guarded,but otherwise just another beach plenty of eateries and cafes,so ok if that's what you want 😎👍

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: Beautiful town by the seashore with a very lively bubbly atmosphere, the cleanliness was amazing of both beach and footpaths. The choice of places to eat and shop was also great an absolute visit again 4 days wasn't enough.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Beautiful beach highly recommend ! Did the Bronte to Bondi walk. The people here are so friendly and the beach is nice and clean.

reviews.title: Just a Beach
reviews.text: Bondi Beach is clean with nice sand, however it's just another beach. I don't find it any more spectacular than any other nice beach. Don't quite understand why it is so popular. I would say the beach is fairly small as well. Can easily walk from one side to the other under 30 minutes. I wouldn't bother going twice. It doesn't stand out to me in any way. If there wasn't so much hype about this place then I wouldn't judge so harshly. There is nice art work painted on the walls, which we spent more time looking at than the beach.

reviews.title: Of course a MUST SEE !
reviews.text: For me it was a bit disappointing. I like Brontë and Tamarama beach much more. But of course this beach is so famous you definitely must go there and see it yourself. Behind the beach many nice restaurants. Busy place.

reviews.title: Not a bad way to spend New Year's eve.
reviews.text: Just another place to tick off the list, would have liked a bit more sun but was still warm and busy.

reviews.title: Wohoo....
reviews.text: One of the best beach we enjoyed in the life. Clean, full of world tourist, exciting, memorable. Best, Best, Best.

reviews.title: Living on its reputation
reviews.text: Got to visit this because of its reputation but I'd rather visit Coogee or Manly. Seen better beaches and better surf and with better places to eat and drink.

reviews.title: Nothing special
reviews.text: Everyone is thinking is the best beach in Sydney. I don't find anything special with this beach, is just very very big. I personally prefer small and intimate beaches. Average.

reviews.title: Bit of a let down
reviews.text: Not what I was expecting... considering  its the beach you hear of as a tourist.. Mainly  much better...

reviews.title: Just go!
reviews.text: Not too much to say. It's iconic. It's busy. There's a big beach to share. It's close to Sydney city and accessible by bus.Swim between the flags are risk getting into difficulties. The currents can be extremely strong here. Listen to the lifesavers/lifeguards.

reviews.title: Famous Local Beach
reviews.text: I was fortunate enough to stay here for four nights on my first visit to Sydney. It was actually fairly quiet due to not the best weather. The shops along the beach are okay, nothing special or unique. A nice place for a morning or sunset stroll. Fun to watch the surfers and a few brave swimmers.

reviews.title: Great beach and Aussie icon.
reviews.text: Went to Sculptures by the Sea on a beautiful sunny day and the experience was lovely. The beach and surrounding area is clean with plenty of cafe’s, bars and lunch time spots to visit. Will be back for many years to come.

reviews.title: Went on Kite Festival - Excellent view - nice place
reviews.text: We went to Bondi Beach on Kite Festival on 9th Sep 2018. We saw different kinds of kites which is awesome place to enjoy and amazed to see all the kites.On that day there is dancing floor is gets refreshed. Super place to rejuvenate

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: An essential summertime spot. Great surf and plenty of places to explore. Great to visit at any time of year.

reviews.title: Went to see sculpture by the see
reviews.text: It’s a great view from the cliffs, dropped my phone on the concrete wouldn’t recommend doing that as phone broke from the contact but otherwise the beautiful sceneries are stunning and make up for my broken phone. 😂

reviews.title: Beautiful!
reviews.text: Always wanted to visit Bondi Beach so while in Sydney it was obviously a must! The beach is gorgeous, clean and bustling with people! Great watching everyone out surfing aswell! I loved it I’d definitely return in the future!

reviews.title: Bondi Beach’s Sculpture by the Sea
reviews.text: Every couple of years I visit this exhibition which is uniquely perched along the cliff walk between Bondi Beach through Bronte to Tamarama Beach. The sculptures were nice but the real beauty were the eroded rock faces, bright colored flowers growing alongside and the sea. I would advise visiting on weekdays (for the lesser crowds and better beachside parking).

reviews.title: BEAUTIFUL BEACH - Sculptures By The Sea
reviews.text: Went to see Sculptures By the Sea at Bondi, we walked from Tamarama Beach along the Coastal walk past all the Amazing Sculptures To Bondi Beach we walked past the Bondi Icebergs Club & were going to have lunch there but it was really busy, on a quieter day this is a beautiful spot to eat & they have really good food, so we walked along the walkway alongside the Beach past a huge wall of Amazing Murals which are really worth seeing, crossed the road & had lunch at ‘The Bucket List’ the food was great, we sat outside overlooking Bondi  Beach, great day out.

reviews.title: Icebergs
reviews.text: Beautiful place, beautiful people, beautiful food. Service a little erratic. Food was excellent. Probably need to book a few months in advance for the restaurant but the bar is more relaxed.

reviews.title: Fun at the Beach
reviews.text: The first attempted swim of the year is always fun,  hopped into the family mobile and off we set down to Bondi beach arrived at 8:45, parking was already hard to find by 9;15 we finally found one. The council make the whole outing so enjoyable when the metered parking is about $3,50 for 30 minutes. By the time you walk from the car to the red and yellow flags you end up with about 15 minutes of actual time in the water so no time to build sand castles.Nothing says beach fun with the Council's greedy hand I  your back pocket.

reviews.title: It’s Bondi Beach
reviews.text: Bondi Beach might be the best-known beach in Sydney which -to me - is enough reason to visit. The beach itself is not mind-blowingly special but it’s definitely a great beach. Water and beach conditions were great (late October) and there are plenty of food options around.

reviews.title: Photo opportunities
reviews.text: It was a bit cool and windy the day we were there. We would have gone swimming otherwise We walked the beach cliff trail instead. The walk was very nice with a lot of gorgeous Pacific Ocean views. We took some wonderful photos and enjoyed a nice cup of coffee at the end. There's a nice fish market in town with delicious shrimp, oysters and lobster.

reviews.title: Brilliant Bondi Beach
reviews.text: Bondi Beach is a very popular beach packed with vibrant buzzing people - and that is the brilliant thing about it. My family really enjoyed the day, here. We really enjoyed using the pool and looking at the sea view. The waves were huge and were beautifully coloured with blue. Both the restaurant and bar had excellent service. I would really reccomend going to this wellknown renowned beach.

reviews.title: Still an icon although constantly changing
reviews.text: It's a must for any tourist, still an icon but more people, more difficult to park, more of a concrete jungle and definitely more coffee shops and cafes.Probably more people around the streets and cafes than on the beach itself.It actually looks more interesting from a distance, i.e having lunch at Icebergs, than being on the ground level itself..

reviews.title: Bondi beach!
reviews.text: This is a must in Sydney, if for nothing else then its legendary name as a must see place.We had hot chocolate at one of the cafes close to Bondi, hot chocolate on a nice cool day, another must when at Bondi. Paid parking available in the lots right near the beach

reviews.title: Bondi - Iconic Sydney ?
reviews.text: Visited Bondi Beach on our hop on / off tour. The town and beach are just as we had imagined sun, sea, surf and thonged with people at the weekend. We decided to take a walk along the coastal trail towards Coogee, as there is currently a modern art exhibition along the way. Worth a visit because it’s iconic Sydney and the coastal trail is highly recommended!

reviews.title: Great beach but?
reviews.text: Definitely over rated beach that’s for sure. But if your in Sydney everyone goes to see it. I think the reviews speak for itself just look all the people saying average

reviews.title: Relaxing day at Bondi
reviews.text: Great places to eat and watch the world go by good open spaces if you don’t like the sand but love the sea views . Nice and flat to stroll around the promenade

reviews.title: Amazing timing with the art exhibition on
reviews.text: Unreal beach with fantastic walk round the coast was lucky enough to see the art exhibition on the walk round and was lucky enough to have the sun shinning up there with one of the best beaches I’ve been to

reviews.title: Likely great during the day, good at night
reviews.text: I went at night, since it was the only time I could go, and had fun seeing the city lights and sticking my toes in the ocean.  I was surprised at the after dark activity there, but enjoyed some great seafood across the street after I was done.

reviews.title: A right royal experience
reviews.text: My friend Joel thoroughly enjoyed meeting the Royal couple at Bondi Beach today. He is a surfer that works with Australians of all ages suffering from depression and uses surf therapy to help them. Bondi is his home beach and was the perfect spot to meet the Royals. HRH Harry is a great supporter of drawing attention to mental health and as patron of Invictus Games is over in Sydney for the games this next week so I would encourage everyone to make time to attend one of the events and check out Bondi beach also!

reviews.title: Just like TV
reviews.text: We did the walk from bronte to bondi and the coastal views were nothing to sneeze at. Bondi was a nice Australian white ssand beach and was closed due to dangerous currents the day we went. Still nice to wet the feet on a stroll. Besides we love Bondi rescue!!!

reviews.title: Fun and nice beach
reviews.text: I know the locals aren't a huge fan of this place, much like the Oahu residents and Waikiki in Hawaii. However, this is a beautiful beach with plenty of people on the sand and in the water. There is the iconic pool off to the side that seems part of the ocean and you can seemingly swim there for under $10 in the pool. There are plenty of eateries, restaurants, and shops at Bondi and is the starting or ending point of the Bondi-Coogee coastal walk.

reviews.title: Great even in cooler weather
reviews.text: What a fabulous beach, its definitely a surfers beach. So many younger kids taking advantage of the great waves to learn how to surf. The area is full of shops and places to grab a bite to eat.

reviews.title: Beautiful Stretch
reviews.text: Unfortunately we didn’t stay as long as we’d like. But the sand and surf were fantastic. October is a little off-season, we’re told, which accounted for the sparse crowd—perfect for relaxed sightseeing.

reviews.title: Late night beach stroll
reviews.text: Arrived later than anticipated to wake from Bondi to Coogee,  but still took a stroll on the beach. Very nice beach,  lovely sand and surf - surfer favorite.

reviews.title: A must do
reviews.text: Bondi beach is probably the most famous beach in the world and if you are in Sydney it is a must do just to say you have been there

reviews.title: Another great beach
reviews.text: One of Sydneys great beaches. offering a great walk along the coast, great cafe and restaurants and great markets and shopping. Makes for a good day out

reviews.title: Day out
reviews.text: Absolutely beautiful beach so close to main st for shopping across the road for Sunday markets. This beach has lifeguards in spring and summer.

reviews.title: fun and enjoy
reviews.text: bondi beach is best place for enjoying with your partner's and friends ....lots of fun with best memories and best sunset view...

reviews.title: Beautiful sunset
reviews.text: If you want to spend a day in a beach and see beautiful people, you may want to visit Bondi beach. The sunset is lovely as the coast turns golden.

reviews.title: Good
reviews.text: This is perhaps one of the best beach in Sydney please do visit with your friends and family and I assure you are going to have a great time

reviews.title: Too Overcrowded
reviews.text: The beach rarely sees a time in spring/summer where the beach is overcrowded. Would recommend Bronte beach to anyone wishing to see a beach in the Sydney region

reviews.title: Wow!
reviews.text: We hear so much about world famous Bondi Beach. Seeing it is not the same! It’s beautiful, wild and exhilarating! When we were there, there weren’t any surfers in the water. It was still worth walking around. The whole area is fascinating. Well worth the detour!

reviews.title: Most Beautiful white sand beach a surfer's paradise
reviews.text: Took a walk through sandy ,partially paved rocky beach upto cliff top. An excellent view from the top .Also surrounded by various eateries and enjoyed Coogee coastal walk.Also can enjoy swimming at an elevated swimming pool. People flock to what is known grassy knoll- tiny grass field .In September every year there is kite festival in the beach.

reviews.title: Had to see Bondi Beach
reviews.text: Using the hop on hop off bus tour we stopped off at the beach. Good weather, fun to watch surfing and lots of places to eat and shop at.

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: Who doesn't love a great beach? And when it's one of the most iconic beaches in the world, even better!Bondi is one of those places everyone should visit if they can, and once you've been once you'll want to keep coming back. The beach is great and so is the surfing.

reviews.title: Best beach in Sydney
reviews.text: Bondi Beach is the best beach you can go to in Sydney. Lots of people, beautiful beach, amazing weather, I would go back to Bondi any given day.

reviews.title: Lovely beach though we weren’t lucky with weather!
reviews.text: We visited in the first week of October and were hoping for warm weather, unfortunately it wasn’t that warm or even sunny.Nevertheless the area, the shops, the beach stroll and even watching the committed surfers in the early morning was worth it.

reviews.title: Bondi beaches
reviews.text: One of the great and famous Sydney beaches.beatifil sands and water unfortunately we could not swim because it was cold for me but we enjoyed the walk and watching people

reviews.title: Nothing special
reviews.text: Visited here on A tour of Sydney. We would have come anyway if not on the tour. Have to say I was expecting magical beach as far as the eye can see, in reality it's just a medium sized crescent which is overlooked by shops and cafes. It's iconic and I guess a must see but it's just an ordinary looking beach.

reviews.title: Nice beach very hipster!
reviews.text: We stayed here one night and the next day walked the beach and had breakfast at an outdoor cafe. Great ambiance and people watching. If you’re into running or yoga not a bad spot to get your morning workout in! Worth the visit if you’re in Sydney.

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: What a beautiful beach. It truly is postcard perfect.Life guards are everywhere which is great (however please always swimming in between the red and yellow flags) Its  clean and so lovely to swim at. Lots of cafes/ shopping close by.

reviews.title: A must do
reviews.text: My husband and I spent the day at Bondi Beach. It was chilly so we did a lot of walking around and had lunch. I definitely recommend the walk from Bondi to Bronte Beach. Breathtaking views and a great way to get some exercise and see the area. I also loved the murals at Bondi Beach. Great place for photo and selfies!

reviews.title: Bondi Beach
reviews.text: If there is one beach you must go to in Sydney, Bondi Beach is it! Beautiful ocean views and sounds. One can easily spend an afternoon there relaxing and walking the coastal trail. Sounds of waves breaking is very therapeutic.

reviews.title: Must visit in Sydney
reviews.text: No visit to Sydney is complete without a trip to Bondi beach. Chilled vibe and lots of restaurants just around if you want to take a break from the beach.

reviews.title: A huge disappointment
reviews.text: I was very disappointed with Bondi Beach. Having heard all about it I was expecting fantastic views and a fabulous long beach. However, the reality is a small beach surrounded by shops - not at all pretty or appealing. If you want to see some stunning beaches in Australia head for the south instead.

reviews.title: Gorgeous
reviews.text: Wow what a beautiful dangerous beach! You would be crazy to swim outside of the flags due to the undertow and rips. It is a fabulous setting with plenty of beach space to spread out. Lots of cafes and shops to investigate just behind the beach and accommodation everywhere. A really great place

reviews.title: Tourist Beach
reviews.text: This is Sydney’s number #1 tourist beach.The beach is clean, beautiful and a lovely compliment to Australian beaches.The beach is under the care of some of the worlds most skilled, educated, trained and experienced life guards you’ll ever come across.If you’re coming here, please please swim between the flags. The currents at Australian beaches can be deadly and often you can’t see the danger from outside the water. If you come into trouble put your hand up for help.This beach doesn’t have many locals visiting, it is 99% tourist only. That is not a criticism, this is definitely a beautiful beach.Like any public place around the world that attracts a lot of tourist... don’t take valuables to the beach to simply leave them unattended as you swim. Theft is a reality we face anywhere in the world. Parking is not great and generally reserved for disabled spaces or timed parking for locals running errands.
