Definitely take a bus from the city or from Bondi Junction which is linked to the train system.There is a nearby walk to Coogee which is great for all ages, fitness levels and mobility levels including wheelchairs.

reviews.title: Nature at its best.
reviews.text: A gorgeous beach on the Australian coastline. Lots of beautiful clean sand to sit and relax. Life guard patrol, swim between the flags.

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: This was my first visit to Bondi, and i guess it has a big reputation as being one of the moost well known beaches in Australia. It is nice, but def not the best i have been to in oz. It does have a nice culture, with lots of surfers, cafes and eateries, a lot of people working out, taking their dogs for a walk and a play. Its a pretty rich and hip place.

reviews.title: Worth the detour
reviews.text: If you have time, it is worth going to see the famous Bondi beach, especially on a nice day. Even if it's too cold to go swimming,  it is fun to watch the surfers. Lots of bars and restaurants near the beach.

reviews.title: Check the weather before heading out at this time of year!
reviews.text: We made a 1.5 hour commute on the train to come here without checking temperatures and wind, and were in for a chilly and very windy time. While it was beautiful watching the sunset along the uninterrupted horizon, I was freezing. Was however pleased to see many food options and bathrooms for a comfortable and delicious evening dinner afterwards. Both affordable and higher range options available.

reviews.title: Awesome beach! Just remember your sun cream!
reviews.text: Bondi Beach is the jewel of Sydney. It's really just massive. Full of holiday goers and the locals surfing and just catching a tan! The water is very powerful though so just take your time in the water if you're not a strong swimmer. Also remember your sun cream I burnt terribly and it was cloudy. Brilliant beach.

reviews.title: Birthday holiday visit
reviews.text: Well you can’t come to Sydney and not visit the infamous Bondi beach can you, if you have time to fit it in the do so. Wouldn’t say that it is a must though, at the end of the day it is a nice sandy beach, could be anywhere. We visited on an unusually hot day and the place was rammed! Plenty of souvenir shops.

reviews.title: A great place even on a cold windy day
reviews.text: So, my group and I decided to see the famous Bondi Beach that everyone told us to see. I will say, the beach did not disappoint. If you’re from the states it’s got a feel of Huntington Beach to it, but the views and the bar scene around the area just doesn’t compete. The food options and souvenir shops right before the beach vary and can give even the group of 10 I went with plenty of options to check out.The only thing that I would say is a downside right now on the beach is the minor construction they have going on, on the beach it isn’t a large area that’s being torn down or renovated but it is noticeable. Other than that, the place is just generally a fun place to be around regardless.I will definitely make a return again when it’s warmer it was a crisp 65F when we went with winds blowing in from the ocean. Needless to say. It. Was. Cold.

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: Very beautiful landscape very clean and easy to access with lot of cozy bars.it is ideal for swimming and surfing.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach!
reviews.text: Took my family of 8 here for a week getaway. Monday- friday there were a few people around , but once it was sat & Sunday there were a lot of people there . Beautiful beach. Rough water though . Clean sand & beach. Lots of tourists everywhere . Heaps of grass to sit if you don’t want to sit on sand. Shops, cafe’s & restaurants across the road . Some parking available but full on weekends . Heaps of street art on the walls, and great to see the Bondi life guards there patrolling the beach.

reviews.title: Great day visit close to Sydney
reviews.text: Great way to spend the day just a short drive from Sydney. Took a swim at the famous Bondi pool. COLD but has a great sauna with glass door and windows overlooking the bay. A definite must.

reviews.title: Somewhat Over-rated Beach
reviews.text: It is large beach and known the world around and has great waves and good sand but it is a somewhat over-rated beach and the street cafe's along the beach are fairly tacky. There are better beaches along the coast but a great place to start the walk to Coogee which is up there with the best in views.

reviews.title: Great place to go to!
reviews.text: Perfect for locals, surfers, and tourists alike! This is hands down the best beach in Sydney and is a great place to visit any time of year. Surfers will love the waves off of the ocean, tanners will love the sands, tourists will love the views. There really is something for everyone. There is also a public pool located off the beach which is perfect for days when you don't feel like going into the ocean. There are cafes and other various dining options as well. A must do while in Sydney.

reviews.title: Nice place
reviews.text: It was one of the biggest and cleanest beach I have ever been in. Still I prefer manly as it is a bit less populated.

reviews.title: Wow Factor
reviews.text: Wonderful, iconic beach centrally located and easy to get to. Not as picturesque as many other Sydney beaches but still has a wow factor - surrounded by  beautiful sandstone rocky outcrops, great sand and lovely surf.

reviews.title: More than a beach
reviews.text: Bondi Beach is famous for the world class beach. Even you are not swimmer, you will have to come to visit this beach in Sydney. Quite often, tourists are seen here with their lugguage pulling around the boardwalk before their flight.The beach is also popular for festival, gathering, sports event and family activity. The one day Festival of the Winds held there and it brought so much fun to the area even it's still a bit cold for swimming.The only setback of the beach is there is no train station so traffic jam is quite often going in if not out.

reviews.title: Beach addicts come here
reviews.text: The world famous Bondi beach draws crowds by the thousands all year long even in winter. Kinda romantic and a must for beach addicts

reviews.title: Marketing exec is a genius
reviews.text: Whoever did marketing for Bondi Beach is an absolute genius. The beach is crowded most of the year, overcrowded in summer with a limited number of reasonably priced places to have a drink or dine after. The nightlife in Bondi is non existent - the beach, although beautiful is flushed with so many people and travel too and from is an absolute nightmare.  There are better beaches to go to - Coogee Bronte Tamarama Maroubra Northern Beaches to name a very few. Well done Marketing team however! Job very well done. Photo taken early morning 8am pre-rush.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: The beach is beautiful! Wish we had come at a different time of year when it’s hot and sunny. Still enjoyed our visit and the walk to Coogee beach. Enjoyable watching the surfers 🏄🏻‍♂️

reviews.title: Bondi
reviews.text: Wrong time of the year or just bad luck 🤔 it’s FREEZING!!!! Such a nice placeloads to do, a buzzing area but your in Bondi so it was a guarantee. The beach is the highlight but it is only 30 min bus/train ride into Sydney! Not much to say really a lot of pubs/cafes/massage parlours.....would recommend though!

reviews.title: Touristy but beautiful
reviews.text: There are lots of tourist and backpackers in the area. Beautiful beach that live up to its hype but can get very crowded in the summer. Parking is a nightmare during public holidays and the summer. You're better off taking the train from the city to Bondi Junction and then taking the bus to Bondi beach instead. There is a Bondi to Coogee coastal walk that passes by several more beaches starting from the Bondi Icebergs end of the beach. Despite the obvious tourist trap and crowd, you will not be disappointed.

reviews.title: One the Best Beaches in the World "Bondi Beach"
reviews.text: "Bondi Beach" located at Eastern part of Sydney is one of the best beach in the world. An absolute must walk when visit Sydney. The walk features 5-6 famous Sydney beaches, stunning views, parks, cliffs, bays and rock pools. I came to know this is also known as Coastal Walk. Good part is, this beach is frequented by locals, tourists, backpackers and the Sydney high society people. It’s not just about the beaches and the views, the path that connected this string of beaches is also flanked by native bush and beautiful flowers that are now in the summer months in full bloom. Lot of eateries around one can enjoy the & relish on food too. Bondi Pavillion is an excellent gallery to visit if you are an art lover. Superb experience and recommended.

reviews.title: it's a legend
reviews.text: A nice spot to enjoy a day in the sun.  Nice if you enjoy a day at the beach and a legend if you're a surfer.  If you're not a surfer,(like me), t's still fun to watch the waves come in and the surfers catch a ride.

reviews.title: There is a reason Bondi is world-renowned
reviews.text: I have been to Bondi probably fifty times over ten years and to swim only about five of those times. I have been to Icebergs at least twenty of those times which overlooks Bondi on the south side. The rest of the times it was to walk along the beach, breakfast at one of the many seaside restaurants, visit Sculpture By the Sea, even to baptise a close friend. Whatever the reason there is something to love about Bondi. Just go there!

reviews.title: Wonderful relaxed but trendy place
reviews.text: Great beach. Some great eateries. V relaxed feeling about the place. Worth a visit ... specially if u r a surfer . Apparently the surf worshippers get in a quick surf before and after work ... 530am they descend on the beach after  the clocks change!

reviews.title: Relaxed
reviews.text: Had a couple of hours here at the beach while visiting Sydney. Just a short train ride and we were there. Had a meal and a few drinks. Walked along the beach even had a chat with guys from Bondi Rescue. A nice day out

reviews.title: Historic • Relaxing
reviews.text: It’s winter when I came here so didn’t go to the water. However just by being here, feel the breeze you’ll feel relax and recharge.Just sit on the bench and bring a book it’s good enough. There are plenty of shops, hotels built in early 1900’s and cafés.

reviews.title: Bit disappointing
reviews.text: Highlight for me at Bondi was watching the Whales migrate from a highpoint at Bondi.  Other than that, it was a bit disappointing.

reviews.title: Overrated
reviews.text: Bondi is probably the most overrated beach in Sydney. When it isn’t full of loud and obnoxious backpackers it has all the people from out west. Coogee is marginally better, maroubra about 100x better.

reviews.title: Beautiful city beach
reviews.text: Was over there after the City2surf and it was really excited to see this beach in winter... small waves and no one in water...

reviews.title: This was exactly what we expected - we had a brilliant day!
reviews.text: We really enjoyed our time on Bondi Beach. It was just as depicted on a TV programme in the UK called Bondi Rescue.The sand was lovely and soft and I was surprised when I waded into the water, very close to the shore, how quickly I sank into the sand and almost lost my balance when a wave came in and can now imagine how easily and quickly someone can get into trouble at Bondi. My short trousers got a soaking but I was rewarded by having a picture taken with one of the Lady Life Guards! Thank you.The entire Bondi area is full of character and life with plenty of cafes and restaurants etc and we were sad when we had to leave to catch our HoHo bus back to Sydney.It was a great day!

reviews.title: Must see
reviews.text: I would definitely recommend a trip to Bondi, we caught the Big Bus there and had only about 45mins to look around, definitely need more time. Lots of nice places in the area to eat and shop. Plus lockers etc if needed.

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: This beach was incredible getting to surf with the locals was incredible . The blue water and the white sand are exactly why this is one of the most iconic beaches on the planet .

reviews.title: Good, but we preferred Manly Beach
reviews.text: We visited Bondi Beach as part of an AAT Kings Sydney half day tour (which I’d recommend as a good way to see main Sydney sights quickly).Weather was good when we visited (despite being Australia winter) and beach and the facilities were nice enough, but not as good as Manly Beach we visited the following day. We would definitely go back to Manly, not so sure about Bondi.

reviews.title: AMAZING
reviews.text: Beautiful and just great. Amazing way to chill and enjoy a lovely view for relaxing mind and soul Really good for workout !!

reviews.title: Worth the trip!
reviews.text: Easy to get to the beach on the bus from the Circular Quay or CBD. Good place to people watch-suspect it isn't as pleasant when everyone and their brother (and sister) are there in the summer. Good cafes/restaurants overlooking the beach. Worth going just so you can say you were there!

reviews.title: One of the more fun beaches in the world
reviews.text: Talk about people watching!  This is the place for it!  It ranks up there with some of the beaches in Mykonos that I've visited.  Large, clean, relatively safe (from sharks as long as you're not stupid), and lots of pretty international people.  Very gay friendly, as is most of Australia.  Bondi is a rather Bohemian crowd too.....not pretentious.  Very laid back.  The area is full of fun restaurants and shops, galleries, to purchase local fare.  It feels a little bit like the beach communities in San Diego, CA.  I would go back again for sure.

reviews.title: Cold and nice view in Winter
reviews.text: Because we went in Winter, so not many people swim, can walk on beach freely. Enjoy half day there. If you have time, walk to the northern end or southern end.

reviews.title: Great even in off-season
reviews.text: Even though I visited during the low season it's still iconic and a must visit location. Despite the mild weather it was still a great place to spend the day. I understand that it can be quite hectic in peak season so perhaps it was even better to experience in a more relaxed time of year. Nice bars and restaurants line the beach allowing you to spend the full afternoon eating and drinking your away around since swimming wasn't much of an option.

reviews.title: Northern end of beach is best
reviews.text: There are better beaches in Sydney, don't forget that.But I suppose, you do need to go to Bondi Beach.Walk to the northern end, the water is clearer and there are less people.

reviews.title: Dr.  Aron Kondasinghe Sudath
reviews.text: Jam packed with people on the weekends.  Beautiful and clean. Breathtaking Ocean View. Great to see people relaxing on the beach.  Understandably more expensive than other parts of Sydney. But worth the visit. Highly recommend it. Dr.  Aron Kondasinghe Sudath

reviews.title: New Zealand and Australia cruise dairy:  Sydney post cruise, Day 1 Part 4
reviews.text: On a sunny summer afternoon in Sydney, we took the bus from the CBD to see the iconic Bondi beach.  The ride took about 30 minutes.  We got off at the bus stop near the center of the beach.  From there we made our way to the grassy area to have a picnic.  We proceeded to the white sand to be among the hordes of tourists enjoying the beach and the sea.  There were various nationalities.The area is wide and can accommodate lots of people.  You can find a suitable spot in the sand and enjoy your visit.  Even if we had not brought swim gear, having been on Bondi beach was still a good experience.  The buses were full on the way back to the CBD. It was completely expected because it was summer peak season.

reviews.title: A must visit when visiting Sydney
reviews.text: Lovely beach, with great waves. Really enjoyed coming here for the day. Highly recommended to those who want to say they been to one of the most famous beaches in the world!

reviews.title: Box ticked - but cold
reviews.text: Took the direct 333 Bus from Stand B on Alfred Street, Circular Quay (with Opal card).Beach had a few surfers and even less swimmers as water is too cold. Majority of people walking along promenade and beach were tourists. Several body builders on gym equipment. Fine views of the crescent shaped beach. We had a walk to the far headland and a snack in the Beach Pavillion Cafe. Spotted a couple of the Bondi Rescue lifeguards briefly!- Spent a couple of hours there - not much more to do in 15’ temperature! Then took 333 bus back.

reviews.title: Good for posers
reviews.text: Caught the bus down from Watson’s Bay. Walking from the main road to the beach involved negotiating a plethora of topless posers, narcissistically using outdoor gym equipment. That aside, the beach was pretty standard. Seen much better elsewhere in Australia and New Zealand.

reviews.title: Great beach for people watching
reviews.text: Good beach to visit.  Lots of shops to visit along the way. Great view for picture taking. Lots of wild cockatoos to see.

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: The sand is super soft but right now, the water is super cold. We enjoyed the view though and the area is very lively!

reviews.title: Good for a few hours
reviews.text: Great beach and good to watch the surfers. Good selection of places to eat and a few shops on the front.

reviews.title: Worth seeing
reviews.text: The famous Bondi Beach is worth seeing, a very wide coastline, good for summer beach time. I went on winter day, not much people, beautiful. I heard summer super packed. Sand in beach is the finest I have seen, extremely soft to your feet. Water is clean and beautiful. Some but not high waves, so perfect for swimming. The iceberg swing pool is only $7 a visit if you want to swim beside the ocean. I didn't realized and was surprised by the absolutely stunning walk after you pass the beach. There is a coastal walk that you would walk for 2 hours to many more beach and areas if desire. Even if you take 10-20mins pass the beach to the right, you will see huge natural stones by the coastline, so don't miss out on that! Overall, I found it is famous for good reason. Worth checking it out.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach.
reviews.text: Very clean beach with a great view and great facilities. Buses pass and there is a lovely path to enjoy a relaxing walk.

reviews.title: It’s not the best beach in the arwa
reviews.text: If you have time go to manly on the ferry for great beaches and great food places. Bondi is nice and a must do but for a relaxing beach go to manly instead

reviews.title: Fantastic beach
reviews.text: Just too many people.  Getting there by public transport is a nightmare.  Be prepared to take a couple of hours out of your day getting to and from this place.  After it took a couple of hours to get here, we took uber back to city, it was just ridiculous by PS.  The sand on this beach was like walking on white fluff and squeaky under your feet.  Was a 22 degree day in winter so everyone was out and about.  I’d hate to see it at 30 degrees 😳.I’ve been there now, don’t need to go back.  Other beaches just as nice.

reviews.title: Nice clean beach
reviews.text: This is a nice clean beach with lots of life guards everywhere. Great shops and restaurants all around the area. It’s on 5he. Us line so that made it really nice

reviews.title: A must
reviews.text: Nice atmosphere, easy taxi ride : to enjoy you only need a couple of hours from CBDI highly recommend

reviews.title: Bondi beach is hard to get too!
reviews.text: As a first timer to Sydney, I presumed you could simply get the train to bondi and walk to the beach. Ummmm - no, it’s some distance still and you may need to get a bus. Avoid driving if you can - it’s a nightmare for parking as everyone (as you can expect) wants to see this beach.Nice beach? Yes - but there are better in Sydney that are easier to get too. Tick it off your list and keep going!!

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: It is nice to visit this beach, we had fun walking on the sand and seeing variety of people surfing, swimming and all sorts activities. Also lots strong people but unique. We are very happy made it to this famous beach and find a good place to spent few hours just walk around and enjoy the semicolon and friendly people. Took hundred of photo. It was fun. I recommend you take friends of family to visit this place.

reviews.title: famous surf beach
reviews.text: Famous surf beach known internationally by most . Nice sea filled swimming pool to one side which looked inviting . Kids loved playing in the sand and paddling. Beach was busy even in middle of the Aussie winter .Worth seeing just to say you have been to Bondi !

reviews.title: Great beach, one of the icons of sydney
reviews.text: What a lovely beach with ample space for doing what you want, be it surfing, swimming, paddling or just relaxing in the sands or on the dunes !

reviews.title: Ocean Icon
reviews.text: Wow! Large beach and blue water forever... there is an ice rink and ferris wheel which is  out of place but somehow works.ample parking and clean sand.

reviews.title: Great views, great surf, relaxing beach
reviews.text: What a great beach...it has spoiled my opinion of other beaches worldwide probably for the rest of my life.  Great views...amazing views and great surf for swimming (or surfing...did not attempt).  One of our best days in Sydney was at Bondi.

reviews.title: Iconic Beach in Sydney
reviews.text: The view is magnificent in my opinion. The beach is big. It was fun to play with my niece, strolling and running around the park. We were also able to fed the birds around the beach. It felt good to just stand at the beach, listen to the breeze and waves, and be grateful.

reviews.title: Pretty
reviews.text: Pretty beach but there are much nicer in Sydney. Its worth going to buy isn't an all day beach. Easy to get to from Sydney center and the surf club restaurant is a must do with beautiful views.

reviews.title: Iconic part of Sydney
reviews.text: Bondi beach,,, what can I say probably the most famous beach  in Australia maybe one of the most famous in the world, myself it’s to popular and to crowded (but that’s me) it seems to be the place you go to be seen,very popular with locals and visitors alike, if you want to get anything to eat or drink take your own or be prepared to pay the price, don’t get me wrong it’s a beautiful beach close to the city and a good place to see,,well serviced by busses from the city,, if you’re visiting Sydney it’s a place to see ,,,,

reviews.title: wow
reviews.text: the beach area is so huge.... there are lots of people especially during summer. we came here last winter (july2016) and there was a ice skating ring in front of the beachhouse. my daughter sprained her ankle while penny boarding along the beach and received medical attention immediately by the lifeguard. they even offer us to send to the clinic nearby. they are so nice and friendly. we could not take a swim last year since its winter, we could not do the same this summer since someone injured...huhu. the beach is pet friendly. you can see dogs (with leash off course) strolling along...

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: They had a ice skating for school holidays Nice sandy beach Hour from CBD Shops for souvenir  and few dinning options

reviews.title: Beach
reviews.text: Large beach. Clean and nice. You must visit Bondi while i Sydney. Be carefull, becouse of large waves and rips. Be aware of thieves.

reviews.title: Beach in the citym great little cliff walk too
reviews.text: Bondi beach is famous for the surfers, but its a great beach just to visit as its easy to get to when in Sydney, just grab an UBER and you are there ein no time.There is a great little clip walk to the right, gives a great view of the beach.Beach it self is not that big but is really nice to go get you toes wet. Really recommended

reviews.title: Nice
reviews.text: Been there with my partner and watech dolphins and surfers surfing on waves together it is unforgettable

reviews.title: Surfer paradise
reviews.text: Visited this beautiful beach while in Sydney. Could just simply sit there watching the waves rushing to the shore. N the surfers with the wakeboard trying to tame the waves. Beside the beach, there are plentiful eateries around to satisfy ur tummy

reviews.title: Spectacular beach, lots of happening during weekends
reviews.text: Came during winter, super windy and made it really chilly. But the winter sun was still very inviting. Plenty of good surfers and good for people watching. Will recommend going to speedos cafe for brunch and iceberg restaurant for a spectacular view

reviews.title: Beach like no other
reviews.text: Beautiful beach with the finest sand I’ve ever touched! The lifeguard is attentive. There is an ice-skating rink, a row of restaurants, shower rooms and toilets and some shops across the street.

reviews.title: Walking with friends
reviews.text: We walked from Coogee beach up to bondi beach and the view is spectacular and breathtaking. I suggest that you wear walking shoes and comfortable clothes. The trail is easy and very nice to do while in Sydney.

reviews.title: Gorgeous blue waves
reviews.text: Had a good time here, even for the winter.  There were still people surfing, and in the water, though the waves were a bit too much for me to consider getting in.  I would recommend going to BBPB (I think that's it?) - a little restaurant right across the street from the beach.  Their fried polenta was cheap and to die for.  Also, there's a great spot to watch the surfers and whale watch in the winter at the South end of the beach - just look for the infinity pool and head that way - even viewing from the walkway/street was gorgeous.

reviews.title: A beach
reviews.text: It’s a beach, nothing else, off course there are quite some big waves for the surf fanatics. Quite some eateries and shops on the promenadeNearest stop Big Bus: Stop 30 (Blue)

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Bondi Beach is iconic for a reason.  It is stunning! The weather was perfect giving us the best possible conditions for our visit.

reviews.title: Lots to do
reviews.text: We went in June so the beach was not crowded at all. In fact, I could probably count the number of people on the beach.   However, my niece and her family went in January and there were probably 20,000 people shoulder to shoulder.  The beach isn’t huge but it is beautiful!  The girls took surf lessons which were awesome! We had lunch overlooking the water, walked around the shops, stopped and took pictures along the graffiti wall and did the Bondi Coastal Walk which is absolutely amazing.  I would highly recommend enjoy Bondi Beach and surrounding area. Just know in summer months it is very crowded.  We were lucky and avoided all the crowds.

reviews.title: OVER RATED
reviews.text: This beach was pretty but very overpacked. If you’re staying in Sydney & looking for a beach day, I’d head over to manly beach! Manly is a bigger beach with a lot less people & was actually relaxing.

reviews.title: Beautiful walk
reviews.text: Fabulous and easy walk from Bronte Beach to Bondi Beach.  A must do if you are in the area.  The rock formations in-between the beaches add to the beauty of the walk.

reviews.title: Great in winter too
reviews.text: We all love Bondi beach in summer. But this year yet again there are attractions to make winter pleasurable.  A huge Ferris wheel and a terrific ice skating rink.  So if it’s too cold for swimming ( not everyone feels the cold as I do) go skating instead. Recommended

reviews.title: Beautiful surf!
reviews.text: So this beach was the last beach we stopped at along our coastal walk from Coogie Beach. The highlight of the beach was the restaurant we ate at overlooking the pools that are in the beach landscape. What a view! It is worth going just to see this! Lots of surfers, and cute town across the way!

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Everyone visiting Sydney has to go to the iconic Bondi beach.Get off the bus at the top on the hill. Walk down to the sea baths. Leisurely walk along the beach past the Bondi Surf life station to the other sea baths.The RSL at the end of the beach is reasonably priced meal with million dollar views

reviews.title: DIP YOUR TOES IN THE WATER
reviews.text: Bondi Beach is one of the world's key beach attractions and should be on your bucket list. The magical waters of the Pacific Ocean create this bay and magnificent beach with pale golden sand stretches before you with beautiful headlands either end of the beach and plenty of places to visit and go. There are eateries/restauranta/cafes and fantastic local shopping. Weekends have markets. The local Pavilion has events and art shows ... so much to offer and so much for you to explore. Get out and about;  get into Bondi and get down to those golden sands and dip your toes in the water! ENJOY!

reviews.title: I was enchanted with Bondi Beach
reviews.text: First of all, I didn't go there with the primary purpose of going to the beach. I had a conference at the Lifesaving Club right on the beach with a great view from the second story window. But my host told me to bring my "swimmers" and I did.Travelling from Sydney, I took the train to Bondi Junction and took a cab from the train station to the beach. Big mistake. I got a rather rough woman cabbie who I am sure took the long way. It was $17 dollars to the beach from the train station by cab. Along the way, she told that the beach was safe because to her recollection, sharks hadn't taken away from the beach in years. Plus there was a shark net out there somewhere.  It didn't deter me.Once there, the beach was everything that one expects from the Australian beaches -- glorious sunshine, golden sand, surfers galore and bathers.  The beach is actually a national surfing monument. There were drinks vendors with colorful umbrellas and the whole scene had a very festive air.  Across the street from the beach were many shops including a McDonalds and an ice cream shop.After my meeting, I had a quick swim, went across the street and got an ice cream and sat down and enjoyed the scenery, including the nubile young surfing bodies of both sexes.  Wondering how I was going to get back to the hotel downtown, I saw a #333 bus that said Downtown.  I got  on it, tapped my Opal card for less than $4 and in about 30 minutes, I was home. It was wonderful -- and all by public transit, on a business trip yet.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Nice neighborhood, with beautiful houses, great views, easy access, nice sands and waves, this beach is great for walking, bathing, eating or taking pictures.

reviews.title: Beautiful trail, cool graffiti
reviews.text: We hiked along the trail near Bondi Beach and ended there to chill. The graffati walls behind were cool.

reviews.title: Bondi beach
reviews.text: Visited in August so it was pretty much deserted. Don’t know why but it was smaller than I had imagined and very little in the way of cafes, restaurants or bars in the immediate area. A little disappointed really.

reviews.title: Nice big beach
reviews.text: Bondi is one of the most famous beaches in Sydney. Big clean beach with lots of tourists but I find Manly beach more beautiful.

reviews.title: Trip with the inlaws
reviews.text: The in laws enjoyed the bondi tour on the big bus when we hopped off. we had a few photos on the beach and had some yummy asian food around the main street. the kids enjoyed the sand and running around. very safe as police walk by the area and life guards are scattered too. toilets are on a quick access near the beach. walkable to shops and good views. just be mindful with your belongings.

reviews.title: The most popular beach in Sydney
reviews.text: Very nice each with lifesavers Change rooms and toilettes All sort of restaurants from budget to very pricy Transport is hideous to get to a train line from the city that never made it to the beach because of the residents but really inconvenient because you have to take buses to get their adding to the unnecessary travel timeParking is really difficult but at the end of all of this still the most popular touristic place

reviews.title: Synonymous with Aussie culture
reviews.text: A melting pot of cultures flock to the ultimate Aussie beach, even in winter. The white, squeaky sand entices and the waves attracts the surfers - expert and beginners looking to try their hand at the beach culture. Easy access from the Sydney CBD via public transport, lots of food places around the esplanade. Probably easier to get there and get your own patch of sand in the off season as it’s out of control in summer.

reviews.title: Wouldn’t make my list of the worlds greatest beaches
reviews.text: Visited Bondi on a cold, windy day so that probably influenced our poor impression of the place. Obviously a great place for surfers (which we aren’t) and the natural shape of the bay is interesting  but otherwise, with the crowds and fun fair rides on the waterfront we didn’t find it a very appealing place to linger.

reviews.title: Beautiful Bondi
reviews.text: Beautiful beach. I've cold water..didn't stop them from enjoying the waves.V safe and cosmo.Wonderful outing.

reviews.title: Chillax
reviews.text: Great beach to go and relax. We went during winter (July) and it was obviously too cold to swim. But it still offers a great beach to relax on and great atmosphere around it. Very accessible by bus and overall would recommend to see - very picturesque

reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.text: We loved the beach, people, vibe and the lifeguards. Great walks and lots to see. Kids enjoyed it and many selfies and photos were taken.

reviews.title: Very nice and clean beach
reviews.text: Nice beach, must visit . Beautiful view from the topIf You like to swim, play, come prepared.Has lots of green grass close to the beach if u don’t prefer to get dirty and enjoy the scenic beach

reviews.title: Beautiful beach even on a cool day.
reviews.text: This is the best beach and easy to get to on the bus.  The sand is very nice,the water is beautiful. We were there on a cool day but there were lots of surfers out and other brave people in the water. It’s a great place to people watch. We went for a swim at the bondi iceberg pool. It’s affordable and lots of fun.

reviews.title: Bondi bondi
reviews.text: we were here in January.  the most famous beach in the world... and I can see why now ! it was extremely busy as apparently is the norm here. the day we were here the waters edge and about 50 meters into the water was full of washed up seaweed which made it difficult to get into the water without getting ones feet  tangled in it.  but once in... the water was amazing. the beach itself is much smaller than we had anticipated  but a very quirky place albeit.  Definately worth visiting if in Sydney  even  if only to sit and people watch. lots of lovely eateries on the prom also.

reviews.title: Love this beach!
reviews.text: Had a great time on this Beach. It is beautiful, a bit smaller than expected but who cares. Such a great vibe in the area and the water was great for a bit of body surfing! We took the bus from downtown and it was really easy to get there and get back. fyi, if you have kids and are concerned about them seeing some topless ladies, then stay towards the east side of the beach.

reviews.title: Lots to do and Fabulous swim
reviews.text: There is a plethora of cafes and food places to eat at, the beach is great if you catch it on a good day, plenty of rnr to be had at Bondi

reviews.title: Ice skating
reviews.text: We visited it during the winter and still it was fun and alive. We walked down the beach while the kids were ice skating, funny combination. Beautiful views of the beach and tons to see and eat.Great environment for all ages.It is a must when visiting Sydney, only 20 minutes by car/can.

reviews.title: An ideal beach.
reviews.text: The beach is really nice and the perfect summer respite from the heat. Even if you go any other time time, you will not be disappointed. Really enjoyed everytime I went there.

reviews.title: Smaller than I thought, but beautiful!
reviews.text: Being a huge fan of Bondi Beach rescue of course I had to visit. It is smaller than appears on tv, however the beach is extremely clean, lifeguards friendly and scenery absolutely beautiful. It's a must see!!

reviews.title: One of the world's best urban beach
reviews.text: Bondi is probably Sydney´s most famous beach and for all the good reasons.As I already wrote in another review (Blue Mountains review), I consider Sydney a very lucky city since, geographically speaking, it got everything you need, including a spectacular coast. Bondi won't disappoint you, with its super clean water (we saw a group of dolphins) and white sand, great day and nightlife, its promenade full of delicious bars- restaurants...its natural swimming pools (some of them are artificial structures though...but they still get filled up by the sea water) and, for those who love surfing, waves are awesome. Water is not that warm though, but hey, is the Pacific Ocean! One thing that I truly like about Australia are their rules, and everybody respects them! The beach is no exception. I heard a lot of people complaining about the too many restrictions (including my favorite one, forbidden to smoke in public areas) that they put, but I like them all. You can't trust humans so better to take extreme measures! Australia should be taken as a world example regarding this aspect.

reviews.title: It's alive!
reviews.text: Bondi had extraordinary beach and amazing town. The beach was excellent just for laying down and enjoying the moment. The town offered varieties of stores and good foods. Getting there was not difficult, though took time because we used public bus. We recommend Bondi to you, particularly for extraordinary beach view and excellent foods.

reviews.title: Funny and hip beach
reviews.text: We walked the Bondi to Coogie Walk, starting at Bondi Beach. It is a really pretty Beach and a great launching point for walks. There is also a lot of street art to look at (with some places perfect for photo shoots)

reviews.title: Go there during sunset!
reviews.text: The famous Bondi, a tad too crowded if you go during the day with families and everyone out.But if you go there near to sunset, it’s not as crowded and you get to see one of the most beautiful views.

reviews.title: Harbour Bridge, Tick; Opera House, Tick; Bondi, Tick!
reviews.text: Mention Australia and a few things come to mind.  The Opera House, Harbour Bridge, Ayres rock and Bondi Beach.  Bondi beach is a go-to place for the tourist and there were plenty there when I visited.  The beach is huge and covered with lovely white sand.  As a people watching beach its fantastic, for sunbathing it is also fantastic and for surfing?  That is what it is known for.The facilities are excellent with showers to wash off the sand.  However, the beach is not the only place to visit in the area.  You must walk to Coogee beach which is wonderful albeit a little strenuous.

reviews.title: Clean, white beach. Not calm waves
reviews.text: June 22, 2018–We went to see this, not swim here.The beach is clean. As a public beach, shower and toilet facilities are some distance from the edge of the water.The sand was powdery. Not white but yellowish.The waves appear to be apt for light surfers.

reviews.title: Whilst it's a nice beach, it's a little too touristy
reviews.text: We walked from Sydney, where we were staying and came here to start the Bondi to Coogee coastal walk. The closest we got to the beach was the grass embankment.  The beach was full of people (it was a nice day), when you walk to Coogee you'll see plenty more beaches, with much more free space!

reviews.title: Clean and beatiful
reviews.text: Sydney's iconic beach. Place gets very crowded during hot days and you can sometimes spot a celebrity here and there. Beach is very clean.

reviews.title: Lunch time walk
reviews.text: Take a train from the city, then take the 380 or 333 from Bondi junction to Bondi beach.  Easy to get to, just make sure you have an OPAL card, makes things easier. Lunch at Surfish cafe was pleasant and relatively cheap.  A visit to Bondi is a must  do for any tourist.

reviews.title: Awesome place
reviews.text: I highly recommend everyone visiting Sydney to also visit Bondi Beach. It is an awesome place and a lot to seen nearby.

reviews.title: Good
reviews.text: This is by far one of the best beaches in the city place to visit with your friends and family and assure you you are going to have a very good time

reviews.title: Famous beach
reviews.text: Bondi is a Sydney icon and we visited on a bright sunny day. The beach itself is quite crowded and although we didn’t swim many others were enjoying the water. Nearby there are plenty of shops and places for good coffee. Parking though is difficult and expensive. Other nearby beaches are just as lovely and are a little less crowded.

reviews.title: beach walk and sculpture trail
reviews.text: Our trip to Bondi  coincided with the Bondi to Bronte sculpture exhibition trail being on . Apart from the beautiful walk along the rocky shoreline, the sculptures provided us with much thought and discussion. If you can time your trip to Bondi during this exhibition, I would recommend it highly.

reviews.title: Fresh air
reviews.text: If you stay in the city take a break and get your ocean fresh air fix. Very relaxing with splendid walks all around.It also has a first class skatepark for intermediate to advanced riders.Easy to get there by buss from Bondi junction.Enjoy!

reviews.title: Shame the weather was bad.
reviews.text: Such a beautiful beach. We love watching the Bondi rescue show.We went down to have a look but the weather was not to good. It was 12 degrees Celsius and blowing a gale of 60 kph. The sand was whipping through and stinging so we didn't stay to long. Just a quick look due to the weather. I will be going back again when the weather is better.Still worth a visit to have a look at this iconic place. I just hope the weather is better for you. Sunny and no wind and nice waves.Surfs up.

reviews.title: Cold breeze and sand
reviews.text: Bondi beach welcome us with great weather and cold breeze. The sands were very fine and cold and so was the clear sea water. It wasn’t crowded thought it was a Sunday, guess the reason was it wasn’t summer then. It was great to be close to nature with the sea gulls & beautiful waves. It definitely have to be on your bucket list.

reviews.title: Not what I expected
reviews.text: Ok so we were a bit underwhelmed by this beach. Everyone knows about Bondi beach and supposedly brags they have been there. Honestly? I have been to more beautiful beaches before and I have heard there are more beautiful beaches in Australia. At least we have been and can now brag about it too!

reviews.title: Great iconic beach
reviews.text: Hubby had never been to Bondi Beach before, so we took the #333 bus from the city (30 min trip). Eateries along the esplanade. Beautiful day for the beach when we were there. Famous for it’s tv show, Bondi Rescue. No filming that day.

reviews.title: A must do
reviews.text: A beautiful beach with a dramatic ocean backdrop.  The walk along the top of the beach takes you past numerous little boutiques and restaurants.

reviews.title: This has to be one of the great beaches of the world
reviews.text: The broad, long beach is clean and white, one half filled with beautiful young bodies, bronzed and sleek, some sunbathing, some surfing; the other half filled with married couples, young families, babies in carriages, toddlers and small children running around, the natural progression of the wilder side of the beach. We loved it.    It also helped that our stroll across the sand was preceded by a great meal at Icebergs, perched high above Bondi.

reviews.title: Sun, Sand and Surf
reviews.text: We got with the Red Bus, the only way to trave. When we arrived we walked along the main drag as there are many boutique shops to take a fancy to. Across the road is the famous Bondi Beach. Not much change to the Pavilion, you have toilets and change facility with many food and restaurant outlets.Take a walk along the boardwalk. If you did one end to the next it would probably be 2 or more km. Those people living on the cliffs on both sides in those apartments or houses have got one hell of a view. One of the best I'd say.Did not go for a dip but we wet our feet.

reviews.title: The seagulls very cute
reviews.text: Today is really cloudy,so not so much people in here.But the ocean still very beautiful.The seagulls are so cute,they even want to eat my watercolor!

reviews.title: A great place
reviews.text: A great beach , perfect outlook.The surprise to us was the shops a few streets back from the beach - lots of eating places and a variety of shops - a real , pleasant surprise

reviews.title: Heavenly
reviews.text: I've been to Bondi Beach for about 4 times already. Every trip to the beach is always a different experience. Include Bondi Beach when you visit Sydney, Australia, explore , enjoy and relax.....by just being there makes me de-stressed my stress. I LOVE bondi beach

reviews.title: The Most Popular Beach in Australia
reviews.text: The Bondi Beach is humongous! It is a beautiful beach with lots of people enjoying the sun. Many also were swimming in the ocean. Others were enjoying themselves with the waves. There was a pool for kids as well.Many had parasols. There was also a real swimming pool next to the ocean. That’s amazing!Some were enjoying the sun on the grass, outside of the beach. We walked around the whole beach. We enjoyed the smell of the ocean, the sun and the exercise. What a great day we had! Time for ice-cream!This is a must to see.

reviews.title: Aussie icon
reviews.text: We picked the worst day possible to visit this iconic beach as it was freezing & pouring with rain. Regardless, we had a good wander along the path & checked out the street art. We were blown away by what a big beach area it is & I could imagine how packed it would get on a beautiful summer day.

reviews.title: Large sandy beach
reviews.text: We visited Bondi Beach on a recent visit to Sydney and had a lovely afternoon there. We were lucky with the weather, the sun was shining and it was pleasantly warm so we saw the beach and surrounding area at it's best!There were quite a lot of people enjoying the beach, but there are no deckchairs or loungers for hire. Most people were sitting and lying on towels and a few had brought their own parasols

reviews.title: Super famous beach!
reviews.text: How many times have we all seen Bondi beach on tv and in films?! Lovely curved beach of white sand with surfing waves rolling in. A very special place, not to be missed visiting Sydney.

reviews.title: Massive beach, good vibe!
reviews.text: The beach is huge! Great for surfing (although I didn't surf!) but enjoyed watching those who were. There's a spot for swimmers too. There are plenty of restaurants and bars in the area and there's toilet facilities on the beach as well as a gym!! Thee beach also has some great graffiti around it!

reviews.title: Not Disappointing at all.
reviews.text: Visited the beach today and although the weather wasn’t perfect the beach was still gorgeous - maybe even more so as it wasn’t packed with tourists! Beautiful views - a must see when in Sydney!

reviews.title: Lovely day
reviews.text: Came to Bondi on a colder day but it was prefect! No wind sun was shining and wasn’t busy at all! Heaps of places around it to, to eat !! But be careful parking can be expensive in areas!

reviews.title: A beautiful beach
reviews.text: The location of the beach was awesome. The beach was beautiful indeed. It was a good place for surfing. We spent our half day at leisure here. Walked around the coast and had plenty of time to sit back relax and enjoy the beautiful view.

reviews.title: Relaxing
reviews.text: I loved visiting this iconic site! Can take some time to get there via public transport but it is quite enjoyable. More trees would make the place better as you will burn fast without sunscreen. But if you protect yourself from the sun it is quite nice. I walked behind the club there as well to discover a Shakespeare play being practiced in a small Ancient Greek styled theatre. Can’t guarantee that’s what you’ll see when you go back there but if you happen to be around give it a little look, might find some other odd things happening back there.

reviews.title: Over rated
reviews.text: Get put and explore further. It ok but there are better beaches. Some nice little restaurants but walk round the back streets to find some others. Pack in summer popular with the younger generation!

reviews.title: Disapointing
reviews.text: Much smaller than we expected. Has a huge reputation considering its size. Has the usual seaside shops and cafes nearby.

reviews.title: Iconic Beach Must Do
reviews.text: My daughters and I returned to Bondi beach the day after their surfing lessons to swim and enjoy the sun and sand. There was plenty of room on the beach on this Friday in late March and the weather and water were perfect - 80 degrees and the water was refreshing.The boardwalk area is a bit of a tourist trap but we enjoyed walking along and had a wonderful lunch.

reviews.title: Go in winter!
reviews.text: I had been wanted that bondi was packed and a bit tacky. However I was there in winter and I had the whole place to myself! Was beautiful and easy to get to on the hop on hop off bus. Get the app for the bus so you can track when the next one is coming in though!

reviews.title: Must do
reviews.text: This is where I want to retire to, what a fantastic place the sand the sea and the surf all amazing.

reviews.title: What is says on the tin
reviews.text: You have to visit BONDI ... rub the the soft sand ... grab a coffee at Lush ... try the fresh fish and chip shop ... choose your fish and then grill or fry ... its on the sea front Lovely place to walk. Relax.  Check out the buildings and see the many different influences ...

reviews.title: One of Australia’s most recognisable beaches
reviews.text: We visited Bondi Beach whilst in Sydney recently.My research showed that the quickest way to reach Bondi from the city was a train to Bondi Junction then a bus to Bondi. There are several buses one can catch from the train station at Bondi Junction. The station is located within the train station.Bondi Beach is one of Australia’s most recognisable beaches after Surfers Paradise. Its such an iconic beach destination. It is a picturesque and a virtually u shaped cove and beautiful white sand to match. Not as white and powdery though as beautiful Boracay in the Philippines.There are lifeguards on duty and this beach is the scene of the popular tv series Bondi Rescue, so be very careful when swimming here and do swim between the flags.The area is dotted with cafes, restaurants , bars, accommodation as well as backpacking accommodation.From the top of the hill one gets great sweeping views of Bondi Beach.

reviews.title: BONDI BEACH
reviews.text: On a recent trip to Australia one of my favourite places to visit has to be bondi beach can't explain you just have to go. Pictures up side down remember this is Australia.

reviews.title: Everything and more even coming up to Winter.
reviews.text: This is the idyllic Beach living. Although I never did the surf lessons for injured knee - just swimming in those waves was so much fun. Great food on the beach front too.

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: We also took the 333 or 380 bus, which is easy to do.  It's a nice beach with fine sand, but it is just a beach which you can find in so many places.  Lots of surfers and surf lessons going on.  We tried to eat lunch at the more moderately priced Icebergs restaurant but never found it, even after asking a few people who work at Icebergs other establishments.  Restaurants uptown were either not open for lunch or were very small with very small menus.

reviews.title: Great place to visit
reviews.text: You can get here on a 333 bus from Circular Quay which goes straight  to Bondi? Glad we came even just to see others surfing

reviews.title: I was expecting more
reviews.text: It’s a nice enough beach, but very touristy and over priced. The beaches either side are much nicer and a better representation of Sydney.

reviews.title: A little Over Sold
reviews.text: We visited Bondi Beach on beautiful fall day. The sky was clear and the air was warm. The beach was not crowded. It is not as beautiful as the images. There is surfing and swimming. It is an ordinary beach and the scenery is just average. It is obvious that marketing is turned up for this beach and the surrounding area. Manly Beach is much more beautiful.

reviews.title: Nice
reviews.text: This is a nice beach with some restaurants and bars and many beautiful blonde Australian women who are very friendly and nice to talk to

reviews.title: Nice beach and close to city
reviews.text: This is a fairly nice and moderately large beach close to the city. Which makes it continent to reach and enjoy. On the other hand it could be little crowded at times. Yellow sand and blue water makes a nice view.

reviews.title: Smaller than it looks on tv
reviews.text: We caught a bus here. It is quite cold at the end of May, but there were still some keen swimmers. The sand and beach is lovely. It's really not as big as it seems on the tv show. The beach itself is not super special, there are similar or even better ones in Queensland. However, the Santorini-like setting of houses around the beach as well as the amazing rocks makes this beach a lovely walk.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach near to city
reviews.text: Takes abt 45-60 mins from city . Amazing beach .we went on weekday ,so pretty much no crowds.buses run quite frequently from city or Bondi junction

reviews.title: Can be Super Crowded
reviews.text: This beach is extremely popular and can be so packed that the sand is not visible.  The fresh ocean breeze makes for a nice walk along the walkway above the beach

reviews.title: Had to see Bondi Beach!
reviews.text: We caught the number 333 bus from Circular Quay and just had enough money on our Opal Card! The beach was very busy with sunbathers and surfers alike. It’s worth a visit just to say that you’ve been to Bondi!

reviews.title: Absolutely beautiful
reviews.text: Stunning and beautiful! At the evening we flew over Sydney in a helicopter ( which I recommend) and we could see it from bird eyes! The sunset was Amazing !!!

reviews.title: Nice clean beach
reviews.text: Just like what you see in the brochures and on tv. The beach itself is really clean and waves seems really good!Lots of seagulls around and also take a walk round the Bondi neighborhood where they have some fun shops to explore and backlanes full of good food!

reviews.title: Good beach, but bit crowded
reviews.text: The beach is clean and you will find lot of people there surfing, riding boats, and like me just walking and enjoying the atmosphere. You will find lot of eateries, shops selling clothing etc...I liked it but my personal choice will be St Kilda beach of Melbourne

reviews.title: Good to watch Surfers
reviews.text: Used the Hop on Hop off bus to get to Bondi plenty of bars and small cafes beach was good but thought Manley had more to offer.

reviews.title: Travel with OPAL to Bondi Junction
reviews.text: Budget trip? Like to take a public transport? Take a bus ride on 380, 381, 382, 333 about 15 minutes journey from Bondi Junction. Don't worry, you won't get lost on the way to the destination. But take good care of your belongings.

reviews.title: Just a beach
reviews.text: Bondi is not what it's hyped up to be. Don't get me wrong, the Icebergs are cool but that's all it has going for it. Bondi beach itself is crowded and in certain areas has a lot of trash. To grab a decent bite to eat you have to walk far up from the beach and there aren't many shops or good places to eat. It's very spread out and not easy to walk around. If you've only got a couple days in Sydney I would absolutely recommend going to Manly Beach instead. Way better experience for sure. Bondi is just a beach, whereas Manly is a whole day experience.

reviews.title: Lovely
reviews.text: Picture paints a thousand words..Check out all the beautiful videos in YouTube. Lovely viewLovely beaches

reviews.title: It’s got to be done
reviews.text: Bus from circular key via Paddington. It’s the iconic beach worth a visit if only to people watch! Easy to get to from downtown via bus.

reviews.title: Awesome beach awesome view
reviews.text: I visited this beach in morning around 9.30am. View was spectacular. You can swim or surf on this beach. Also you can walk further towards Coogee beach. I walked till Bronte beach (towards Coogee) and it was amazing experience.

reviews.title: Totally meets expectations
reviews.text: Lovely clean, sandy beach, not too crowded at this time of year. Plenty of good facilities including fresh water showers. Near to a large selection of shops and restaurants. As public beaches go, this is a good one.

reviews.title: Great stop for lunch
reviews.text: We wanted to see the beach we had heard so much about. We drive, parking was easy but not free. Beach was busy but we made it a lunch stop and ate at one of the outdoor boardwalk restaurants. There are many shops along the road well.

reviews.title: Awosme
reviews.text: Water was chillingly cold.. Though our toddler enjoyed.. But there were lots of stinging jelly fish.. We were made aware of it by a tourist.. So just careful
